paper.title: Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as general-purpose educational and technical assistance systems, but their underlying infrastructure does not treat languages equally. One underexamined source of disparity is tokenization: semantically equivalent content can require substantially different token counts across languages, affecting API cost, latency, and usable context length before a model is invoked. We introduce the Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA), a reproducible benchmark for me

summary.core_problem: 该工作衡量同一份技术 tutoring 内容在不同语言下被 tokenizer 切成多少 token，以及这种差异如何转化为 API 成本、延迟和有效上下文长度的不平等。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发点在 tokenizer 和 multilingual data infrastructure。它提醒预训练团队，语言覆盖不只由语料规模和 benchmark 表现决定，也由词表训练、BPE 合并分布、byte fallback、代码混排文本处理共同决定。对于低资源语言，token fertility 偏高会直接降低训练和推理效率，也会让同样的上下文预算容纳更少语义内容。该工作规模不大，更像一个审计协议和问题定义，而不是新的 tokenizer 训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: TEA 构造了 120 条 beginner Python debugging / tutoring 内容，从英文翻译到 Bengali、Hindi、Arabic、Tamil、Yoruba。内容分三档：35 条短技术短语，50 条短解释，35 条较长教学内容和小代码例子。Python 关键标识符、错误名、代码 token 保留英文，以贴近真实编程教学中的 code-switching。Bengali 和 Hindi 做了主要人工校验，其他语言作为探索性对照。方法上比较 GPT-4o 的 o200k_base、Qwen2.5-7B tokenizer、Mistral-7B tokenizer，指标包括 token fertility ratio、有效 context window 和示例 API cost premium。一个细节值得注意：Bengali 按 Bengali-script 字符比例分为 clean、mixed、English-retained，并报告 clean-only 子集，避免因为英文技术词保留而低估 Bengali 的 tokenizer penalty。
summary.experiments: 实验核心是可复现审计，而不是训练新模型。数据规模为 120 个源项目、6 种语言、3 类 tokenizer。论文明确指出 Bengali 和 Hindi 是主要验证语言，Arabic、Tamil、Yoruba 的翻译质量只能作为探索性比较。结果方向是非英语技术 tutoring 内容存在明显 tokenization premium，并会压缩有效上下文和增加按 token 计费的成本。当前给出的正文片段没有完整结果表，因此不宜补写具体倍数或百分比。阅读时应以 token fertility、effective context window、cost premium 三类表格为准，尤其看 Bengali clean-only 与 all Bengali 的差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 TEA Benchmark 的数据构造、code-switching 处理、Bengali clean/mixed 分层，以及 tokenizer 比较表。对预训练团队更有用的是方法论：如果要训练面向低资源语言和代码混排场景的 tokenizer，可以把这类审计加入 tokenizer selection gate。无需花太多时间在教育应用叙述上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures how much more expensive, in tokens, semantically equivalent technical tutoring content becomes when written in underserved languages rather than English.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining is about tokenizer design and multilingual infrastructure. Language coverage is not only a question of corpus size or downstream accuracy. It is also shaped by vocabulary learning, BPE merge allocation, byte fallback behavior, and mixed code-natural-language text. Higher token fertility means higher training and inference cost, shorter effective context, and more pressure on local deployments. The contribution is mainly an audit protocol and a focused dataset, not a new tokenizer training algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: TEA contains 120 beginner Python debugging and tutoring items translated from English into Bengali, Hindi, Arabic, Tamil, and Yoruba. The items are split into three tiers: 35 short technical phrases, 50 short explanations, and 35 longer tutoring examples with small code snippets. Python identifiers, exception names, and code tokens are kept in English to reflect real code-switching practice in programming education. Bengali and Hindi are the main validated languages; the other languages are exploratory. The audit compares GPT-4o o200k_base, the Qwen2.5-7B tokenizer, and the Mistral-7B tokenizer using token fertility ratio, effective context window, and illustrative API cost premium. A useful design detail is the Bengali sensitivity analysis: items are grouped by Bengali-script character share into clean, mixed, and English-retained subsets, so the measured penalty is not hidden by retained English technical terms.
summary_en.experiments: The experiment is a reproducible tokenizer audit rather than model training. The concrete setup covers 120 source items, six languages, and three tokenizers. The paper states that non-English technical tutoring content carries a practical tokenization premium, which affects cost and usable context length. The provided text does not include the full numeric result tables, so exact multipliers should not be inferred. The key experimental checks are the token fertility tables, the effective-context calculation, the cost-premium examples, and the Bengali clean-only analysis versus the full Bengali set.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction, the treatment of code-switching, the Bengali clean/mixed split, and the tokenizer comparison tables. For pretraining teams, the main takeaway is operational: tokenizer selection for multilingual and code-mixed settings should include an explicit fertility and cost audit. The education framing is secondary.

recommendation.zh: 把“多语token不公平”量化成可复现实验，这点比口水讨论强；但语料很小且是翻译体，结论更像风险雷达，读指标定义与对比表就够。
recommendation.en: It operationalizes multilingual token inequity with a reproducible audit—more useful than hand-wavy complaints; but the dataset is tiny and translation-biased, so treat it as a risk radar and focus on the metric + tokenizer comparisons.

paper.title: Instability of LLM Pre-Pretraining: It Doesn't Always Help. An Investigation on Multiple Languages
paper.abstract: Pretraining LLMs on artificial languages ("pre-pretraining") is a technique that could reportedly increase token efficiency by 33%, i.e., save up to 33% of training tokens needed to reach a certain performance. We validate this prior result for English on a larger set of natural languages across four language families, using two different tokenizers and varying model sizes. We also relate the observed gains (or losses) in token efficiency to quantified linguistic properties of the languages, suc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“人工语言预预训练是否偶尔有效”，而是更严格的问题：把模型先在人工形式语言上训练一小段，再转到自然语言继续预训练，这种做法是否能稳定提升 token efficiency，而且这种提升能否跨语言、跨 tokenizer、跨模型规模复现。作者把已有主要基于英语的小规模结论，扩展到 6 种自然语言、两类 tokenizer、三档 Llama 3 风格模型，并专门检查随机种子、人工语言类型和语言学属性对结果的影响。全文给出的结论比较克制：英语小模型上能复现先前收益，但一旦扩到更多语言和设置，收益并不稳，方差很大，很多 setup 下甚至会反向伤害后续自然语言训练。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给“pre-pretraining on artificial languages”这条线降了温：这不是一个可以直接写进 recipe 的稳健技巧，更像是对初始化和优化轨迹有条件影响的干预，收益高度依赖 tokenizer、模型大小、语言类型和 seed。第二，它提醒做 low-resource 或 curriculum pretraining 的人，不能只看单次 run 或单语言结果；如果一个方法的效应量和 seed 方差同量级，那么工程上就很难当成可靠配方。对 scaling/data-efficiency 研究也有启发：所谓 token efficiency gain 可能并不是来自模型学到了可迁移的“语法能力”，而可能部分来自更容易优化的 early-stage parameter shaping，这种效应在不同 tokenization 粒度下会明显变化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上并不复杂，但实验设计比较扎实。作者选了两类人工语言：k-Dyck 表示严格嵌套依赖，k-Shuffle Dyck 允许打破良嵌套并引入 cross-serial dependency；k 取 64 和 128。人工语言序列统一用数字表示括号对，随后交给不同 tokenizer 编码。这里一个关键变量是 tokenizer：Llama 3 tokenizer 往往把数字串作为较完整 token 处理，而 Gemma 3 tokenizer 会把数字拆成单个 digit，这会显著改变人工语言的表面统计结构，也改变模型在预预训练阶段实际接收到的模式复杂度。

自然语言侧，作者选了英语、阿尔巴尼亚语、捷克语、丹麦语、荷兰语和芬兰语，覆盖四个语系。训练语料由 FineWeb/FineWeb2、OpenSubtitles 和 EUBookshop 按 8:1:1 混合。人工语言预训练固定为 16,000 个长度 2,048 的序列，即 500 steps、batch size 32；自然语言阶段固定为 320,000 个长度 2,048 的序列，即 10,000 steps、batch size 32。模型是三档 Llama 3 架构变体，配两种 tokenizer，总共六个模型，规模大致从 253M 到 884M；文中也反复提到其中最小档模型在英文部分与先前工作最可比。

评估指标沿用 prior work 的 token efficiency gain：看预预训练模型比 base 模型提前多少自然语言 token 达到同样的验证损失；如果更差则记负值。作者没有只报单次曲线，而是每个 setup 跑 3 个随机种子，并进一步把 gains 与语言学属性关联，包括句长、形态丰富度、依存树深度、子节点数、crossing dependencies 等。全文的技术重点不在提出新算法，而在把“人工语言迁移”从一个看起来成立的现象，拆成可检验的条件效应。
summary.experiments:
最重要的实验观察有四个。

第一，方差很大，而且不是只出现在边缘 setup。无论小模型还是更大模型，相同配置下不同 seed 的 token-efficiency gain 波动都很明显。作者明确说，很多 setup 的收益或损失都对 seed 很敏感，这直接削弱了“稳定节省训练 token”的说法。

第二，英语小模型上，先前结论大体能复现。文中指出，最小模型在英语上对多数人工语言预训练设置都能得到持续正收益，只有 64-Shuffle Dyck 例外。这说明 prior result 不是完全站不住，但适用范围比先前印象窄得多。

第三，最稳定的正例是较小模型配 Llama tokenizer、并在 128-Dyck 上预预训练。文中多次点名 154M+LT+128-Dyck 这个 setup 能较一致地带来改进。相对地，Gemma tokenizer 的结果整体更弱、更不稳定，说明人工语言收益很可能依赖 tokenization 是否保留了“括号配对/符号级结构”的紧凑表示。

第四，Dyck 通常比 Shuffle Dyck 更可靠，至少在 LT 模型上如此。这个结果说明，严格嵌套结构比含 crossing dependency 的更自由结构，更可能给后续自然语言建模带来有利初始化。一个合理解释是：前者更像在训练注意力和状态表示去追踪层级闭合关系，而后者虽然形式上更一般，但对小模型和当前 tokenizer 来说可能更噪、更难学。

数据规模方面，人工语言阶段约 16,000×2,048 ≈ 32.8M token，后续自然语言阶段约 320,000×2,048 ≈ 655M token。作者也强调这些训练都不是 Chinchilla-optimal token/parameter regime，但 loss 曲线在最后约 3,000 steps 已较稳定，因此 baseline 与 pretrained 的相对排序大概率不会因继续训练而逆转。全文还做了额外实验去排查不稳定 setup，并尝试把收益与语言学属性联系起来；从给出的结论看，这些属性能解释一部分趋势，但远不足以把效果变成可预测、可稳定复现的 recipe。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，先建立总判断：这不是“方法无效”，而是“效应条件化且高方差”。然后看 Dataset/Experimental Setup，重点注意三件事：人工语言是如何编码成数字串的；LT 与 GT tokenizer 对这些数字串的切分差异；人工语言阶段和自然语言阶段的 token 预算分别是多少。

接着看主结果图，尤其是最小模型的多 seed 曲线，以及作者反复提到的 154M+LT+128-Dyck 这个稳定正例。这里要关注的不是平均 gain 数字本身，而是 run-to-run variance 是否已经接近甚至超过平均收益。再看附录里更大模型和不同 tokenizer 的图，能更清楚地看到“英语可复现”与“跨语言不稳定”之间的张力。

如果只打算花 20-30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → Table 1/2 → Figure 1/3/4 → 英语结果表 → Appendix 中 tokenizer 差异和更多曲线。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 tokenizer 是否才是这个现象的真正主导变量；二是 token-efficiency gain 这种定义在高方差场景下是否足够稳健，是否需要配合 area-under-curve 或 fixed-budget final loss 一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a stricter question than prior work: if a model is first trained on an artificial formal language and only then continued on natural language, does this reliably improve token efficiency across languages, tokenizers, and model sizes? Earlier evidence was largely English-only. Here the authors extend the setting to six natural languages from four language families, two tokenizer families, and three Llama-3-style model scales, while explicitly measuring seed sensitivity. The full-paper conclusion is cautious: the English small-model result is reproducible, but the effect is not robust once the setup broadens. Variance is large, and some configurations hurt rather than help downstream language-model pretraining.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about proposing a new recipe and more about stress-testing an attractive one. For pretraining research, this matters in two ways. First, it weakens the idea that artificial-language pre-pretraining is a generally reliable token-saving trick. The gains look conditional, not recipe-like. Second, it is a useful warning for low-resource pretraining, curriculum design, and transfer studies: if the effect size is on the same order as seed variance, the method is hard to operationalize. The paper also suggests that the observed token-efficiency gains may not come from learning broadly transferable “syntax” in any simple sense; they may partly arise from shaping the early optimization trajectory, and that shaping is strongly mediated by tokenization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is primarily experimental, but the design is careful. The authors use two families of artificial languages: k-Dyck, which encodes strictly nested dependencies, and k-Shuffle Dyck, which relaxes well-nestedness and allows cross-serial dependencies. They test k=64 and k=128. Bracket symbols are represented as integers, and this turns out to be important because the two tokenizers treat those strings very differently: the Llama tokenizer tends to preserve multi-digit numbers more compactly, while the Gemma tokenizer often splits them into individual digits. That changes the effective surface statistics of the artificial corpus and likely changes what the model actually learns during the pre-pretraining phase.

On the natural-language side, they study English, Albanian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, and Finnish. Training data is a monolingual multi-domain mixture of FineWeb/FineWeb2, OpenSubtitles, and EUBookshop in an 8:1:1 ratio. The artificial-language phase is fixed at 16,000 sequences of length 2,048, i.e. 500 steps with batch size 32. The natural-language phase is fixed at 320,000 sequences of length 2,048, i.e. 10,000 steps with batch size 32. Models are three Llama-3-based sizes paired with two tokenizers, yielding six model variants overall, roughly spanning the low-hundreds-of-millions to sub-billion range.

The main metric follows prior work: token-efficiency gain, defined as how many natural-language training tokens earlier the pretrained model reaches the same validation loss as the corresponding baseline. Negative values indicate harm. Crucially, each setup is run with three random seeds, and the paper also correlates gains with quantified linguistic properties such as sentence length, morphological richness, dependency-tree depth, branching, and crossing dependencies. The technical novelty is not a new algorithm; it is a systematic decomposition of a previously positive result into setup-dependent effects.
summary_en.experiments:
Four findings matter most.

First, variance is high, and not only in fringe settings. Across both small and larger models, identical configurations can produce noticeably different token-efficiency gains under different seeds. This directly limits the claim that the method reliably saves training tokens.

Second, the earlier English result is broadly reproducible for the smallest models. The paper states that, in English, most artificial-language pretraining settings improve the smallest model, with 64-Shuffle Dyck as the main exception. So the prior observation is not invalid, but its scope is narrower than one might infer from English-only evidence.

Third, the most stable positive case is a small model with the Llama tokenizer pretrained on 128-Dyck. The paper repeatedly highlights the 154M+LT+128-Dyck setup as consistently beneficial. By contrast, Gemma-tokenized models are weaker on average and less stable, which strongly suggests that tokenization is not a minor implementation detail here; it is a major determinant of whether the artificial-language signal is preserved in a learnable form.

Fourth, Dyck is usually more reliable than Shuffle Dyck, at least for the Llama-tokenizer models. A plausible interpretation is that strict hierarchical closure provides a cleaner training signal for attention and state tracking than the more permissive crossing-dependency variant, which may be harder and noisier under the tested tokenization and scale regime.

In terms of scale, the artificial-language phase is about 16,000×2,048 ≈ 32.8M tokens, followed by roughly 320,000×2,048 ≈ 655M natural-language tokens. The authors note that these are not Chinchilla-optimal token/parameter ratios, but the loss curves are stable in the final ~3,000 steps, so the relative ordering between baseline and pretrained runs is unlikely to flip with more training. The paper also includes additional experiments on unstable setups and attempts to relate gains to linguistic properties. Those analyses explain some trends, but not enough to turn the method into a predictable or robust recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1 to get the main message right: the paper is not saying the method never works; it is saying the effect is conditional and high-variance. Then read the dataset and setup sections carefully, especially how the artificial languages are encoded as number strings, how LT and GT tokenize those strings differently, and how small the artificial-language phase is relative to the natural-language phase.

Next, inspect the main multi-seed result plots for the smallest models, then the larger-model plots in the appendix. The key question is not the mean gain alone, but whether run-to-run variance is already comparable to or larger than the average benefit. Also pay attention to the highlighted stable case, 154M+LT+128-Dyck, because it shows the phenomenon is real in at least one regime.

For a 20-30 minute skim, use this order: Introduction → setup tables → Figure 1/3/4 → English results table → appendix plots on tokenizer differences and larger models. The two most useful follow-up questions are: whether tokenization is the dominant hidden variable behind the whole effect, and whether token-efficiency gain is a sufficiently stable metric in such a high-variance setting, or should be paired with fixed-budget final loss and trajectory-level summaries.

recommendation.zh: 这类论文该看，因为它专门拆穿“训练小技巧在单次实验里看起来很灵”的幻觉；重点读 seed 敏感性和 tokenizer 交互，别只记住 128-Dyck 还能赢一点。
recommendation.en: This is worth reading because it punctures the usual illusion that a training trick is real just because one run looks good; focus on seed sensitivity and tokenizer interaction, not just the residual 128-Dyck win.

paper.title: Beyond Initialization Loss: A Systematic Study of Token Embedding Initialization Strategies for LLM Vocabulary Extension
paper.abstract: Vocabulary extension is an efficient way to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to new languages, but the initialization of newly added token embeddings can strongly affect continued pre-training (CPT) efficiency. We present a systematic study of more than 20 initialization strategies for Hindi vocabulary extension in Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Our comparison spans vocabulary-averaging baselines; external and learned initialization methods, including FOCUS, top-k semantic retrieval, and

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个很具体但容易被低估的问题：给已有 LLM 扩展新语言词表后，新加入 token 的输入 embedding 和输出 LM head 应该如何初始化，才能减少继续预训练早期的冷启动损耗。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据和 tokenizer 研究有直接参考价值。低资源语言适配通常会先看到 tokenizer fertility 的收益，但真正训练时还会遇到 embedding manifold 对齐问题。论文的价值在于把这个问题拆成可实验验证的初始化选择，而不是只用随机初始化、均值初始化或经验规则。它提示一个实际 recipe：词表扩展后，不要只看 step-zero loss，最好用很短的 CPT probe 来选初始化方案。
summary.technical_approach:
实验对象是 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 的 Hindi 词表扩展。原 tokenizer 有 131,072 个词表项，其中只有 1,569 个包含 Devanagari 字符，约 1.2%。作者从 Nanda tokenizer 加入 25,600 个 Hindi token，在 100,000 篇 Sangraha Hindi 文档上把 fertility 从 1.95 降到 1.25 tokens/word。

方法上比较了 20 多种初始化配置，覆盖五类设计轴：词表均值类 baseline，外部语义编码器或 learned mapping，例如 FOCUS、top-k semantic retrieval、residual MLP；基于旧 tokenizer 分词结果的 subword composition；norm calibration；以及输入 embedding 和输出 head 的非对称初始化。

核心发现是 subword composition 最稳。也就是把新增 token 按旧 tokenizer 拆成已有 subword，再用这些 subword 的 embedding 加权平均来初始化。相比外部 encoder 或 learned projection，这种方法更直接利用了原模型已经学到的 embedding 几何，避免把另一个语义空间投影进来带来的错配。最佳配置是输入侧使用 uniform subword averaging，并做 Hindi-specific norm calibration；输出侧使用 character-length-weighted subword averaging。输入侧 MuRIL-BERT semantic weighting 加输出侧 character-length weighting 的结果接近，说明外部语义信号在输入侧有帮助，但不是主要增益来源。
summary.experiments:
关键实验有三点。第一，词表扩展带来明确的压缩收益：Hindi fertility 从 1.95 降到 1.25，等价内容的序列长度明显下降。第二，初始化策略之间差异显著，subword composition 系列整体优于词表均值、外部 encoder 映射和 learned mapping。第三，step-zero initialization loss 不能充分预测后续训练表现；作者建议运行约 50 个 CPT step，约 0.42B tokens，作为轻量初始化筛选。这个结论对大规模 CPT 很实用，因为初始化错误会把早期算力消耗在 embedding 对齐上，而不是语言建模能力提升上。

消融层面，输入侧 norm calibration 和输入/输出非对称初始化都有增益。输入 embedding 更关心 lookup 后进入网络的表示尺度和局部几何；输出 head 更关心 logits 分布和候选 token 的生成可分性。因此把两者用同一种规则初始化并不总是合适。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 tokenizer 扩展设置、初始化方法定义、step-zero loss 与短程 CPT 表现的关系，以及 asymmetric initialization 的消融。最值得带走的是工程 protocol：先用 subword composition 做强 baseline，再分别调输入侧 norm 和输出侧 weighting，最后用几十步 CPT probe 选方案。外部 encoder、FOCUS、MLP mapping 的部分可以快速看，主要用于理解为什么复杂方法未必优于原模型内部 subword 几何。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important engineering problem: after extending an existing LLM vocabulary for a new language, how should the newly added input embeddings and output LM-head vectors be initialized so that continued pretraining does not waste early compute on representation alignment.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to tokenizer and continued-pretraining practice. Vocabulary extension reduces fertility for underrepresented scripts, but it also creates untrained parameters inside a pretrained geometry. The useful contribution is not a new tokenizer, but a controlled comparison of initialization choices and a practical selection rule: do not rely only on step-zero loss; run a short CPT probe before committing to a full run.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study extends the Hindi vocabulary of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. The original tokenizer has 131,072 entries, with only 1,569 entries containing Devanagari characters, about 1.2%. The authors add 25,600 Hindi tokens from the Nanda tokenizer. On 100,000 Sangraha Hindi documents, this reduces Hindi fertility from 1.95 to 1.25 tokens per word.

They compare more than 20 initialization configurations. The design space includes vocabulary averaging baselines, external or learned methods such as FOCUS, top-k semantic retrieval and residual MLP mappings, subword composition, norm calibration, and asymmetric initialization for input embeddings versus the output projection.

The strongest family is subword composition. A new token is tokenized by the old tokenizer, and its vector is initialized from a weighted average of the constituent old-token embeddings. This directly reuses the pretrained embedding geometry, which appears more reliable than projecting from an external semantic space. The best reported configuration uses uniform subword averaging with Hindi-specific norm calibration for the input embedding, and character-length-weighted subword averaging for the output head. A MuRIL-BERT semantic input weighting paired with character-length output weighting performs nearly the same, suggesting that external semantic information can help on the input side but is not the main driver.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical points are clear. First, the vocabulary extension gives a large compression gain for Hindi: fertility drops from 1.95 to 1.25 tokens per word. Second, initialization strategies differ enough to matter in early CPT, and subword composition consistently beats simple vocabulary averaging, external encoder projection, and learned mapping variants. Third, step-zero initialization loss is an incomplete proxy for downstream CPT behavior. The authors propose a lightweight probe of about 50 CPT steps, roughly 0.42B tokens, to select the initialization before a larger run.

The ablations indicate that input-side norm calibration and input-output asymmetry both help. The input embedding must match the residual stream scale and local manifold seen by the network, while the output head directly shapes the logit distribution. Treating them as the same object is convenient but not always optimal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the vocabulary-extension setup, the definitions of the initialization families, the comparison between step-zero loss and short-horizon CPT, and the asymmetric input/output ablations. The main reusable recipe is simple: start with subword composition, tune input norm calibration and output weighting separately, then choose with a short CPT probe. The sections on FOCUS, semantic retrieval, and residual MLPs are useful mainly as negative or weaker baselines against the internal subword-geometry approach.

recommendation.zh: 这类词表扩展小问题常被拍脑袋处理，这篇把 ablation 做得够全；若你做 multilingual CPT，先复现 input/output 非对称初始化，再别迷信 init loss。
recommendation.en: People usually hand-wave vocabulary extension; this one is worth reading because the ablation is broad and it breaks the habit of trusting initialization loss as a proxy for CPT quality.

paper.title: Pruned BPE: Post-training Visibility Pruning and Token Reallocation for Byte Pair Encoding
paper.abstract: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is widely used for subword tokenization, but standard BPE exposes every learned merge token to the downstream model, including tokens that mainly serve as intermediate construction units and rarely appear in the final encoded corpus. This paper proposes Pruned BPE, a post-training visibility-pruning and token-reallocation method that separates merge construction from model-visible vocabulary selection. After standard BPE training, tokens are evaluated by final exposure.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 BPE 词表分配里的一个老问题：BPE 的训练目标是逐步构造高频 merge，但语言模型真正看到的是最终编码后的可见 token 集。两者并不一致。很多 merge token 在训练过程中有用，只是作为更长 token 的中间节点存在；等最终编码完成后，这些 token 几乎不会真正出现在语料里。标准 BPE 仍然把它们放进模型可见词表，等于把有限的词表预算花在低暴露、低训练频次的 token 上。论文要解决的不是“怎么剪小词表”，而是“在保持可见词表大小不变的前提下，如何把可见词表从中间构造节点里解耦出来，重新分配给更值得暴露给模型的 token”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在 tokenizer 设计，而不是建模或训练 recipe。本工作提出了一个很具体也很实用的观点：BPE 的 merge 学习过程和 LM 的可见词表选择不必绑定。这个切分是有价值的，因为 tokenizer 往往被当成一次性离线组件，但它直接决定序列长度、embedding 参数利用率、不同语言脚本的分词质量，以及低频 token 的训练充分性。论文尤其点到了 byte-level BPE 在 Unicode 多字节脚本上的问题：中文、日文、韩文等更容易产生只对 merge 树有用、对模型无直接价值的中间 byte 片段。如果全文实验成立，这类后处理式词表重分配提供了一条低成本改进路径：不改模型结构，不改 BPE 主训练流程，只在 tokenizer 训练后做可见性筛选和 token 槽位重分配。量级上，它更像是 tokenizer 工程层面的稳健增益，而不是会改写 scaling 行为的大改动。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步，先按标准 byte-level BPE 正常训练，得到完整 merge 树和一批按 merge 顺序生成的 token。这里没有改 BPE 的核心学习规则，也没有在训练时引入额外目标。第二步，训练完成后，用 fully encoded corpus 统计每个 learned token 的 final exposure，也就是在最终编码结果里它真正作为输出 token 出现的频次，而不是它在 merge 过程中被使用的次数。作者据此把 token 分成两类：可见 token 和 internal-only token。低 exposure token 仍保留在 merge 树里，继续作为内部构造节点参与更长 token 的形成，但不再分配给模型可见词表 ID。第三步，为了保持目标可见词表大小不变，作者继续在原 BPE 训练基础上 resumed training，训练到超过原目标词表大小，从后续候选 merge 中挑选 exposure 更好的 token，回填被剪掉的可见槽位。

编码时的关键设计是：先按完整 merge 规则做标准 BPE 编码，得到最终 token 序列；如果其中某个 token 被标记为 internal-only，则递归展开成其可见子节点，直到输出序列只包含 visible vocabulary 中的 token。这样做保留了 merge 树的构造能力，但把模型接口限制在重新筛选后的可见词表上。论文强调这不是普通 vocabulary pruning，因为词表大小不变，merge 顺序也尽量保持；变化的是哪些 token 对模型可见。

从方法取舍看，这个设计比“直接按频次删 token”更稳，因为它不破坏更长 token 的生成路径；也比“重新训练一个更大的 tokenizer 再截断”更可控，因为它显式区分了构造节点和可见节点。作者还做了 vocabulary-only evaluation，用共享的 exact minimum-token objective 去剥离 native BPE merge-order 编码差异，试图证明收益来自可见词表组成，而不只是编码器实现细节。这一点是全文里比较关键的论证。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可以确认，实验重点不是大规模下游 LLM 预训练，而是 tokenizer 层面的词表质量评估与编码效果比较。作者提供了 shared exact minimum-token objective 的 vocabulary-only evaluation，用来在相同最短分词目标下比较标准 BPE 与 Pruned BPE 的可见词表组成差异。论文还强调实现支持 Unicode-aware pretokenization、自然语言与代码边界、CPU 并行训练、sharding 和 checkpoint，说明实验应覆盖多语种或至少包含非拉丁脚本场景。

就方法预期而言，关键观察应包括几类：一是低 final exposure token 在标准 BPE 词表中占比不低；二是把这些 token 改成 internal-only 后，最终编码长度不会明显恶化，否则说明只是把问题转移到了更长序列；三是回填的新 token 在最终语料中暴露更高，词表利用率更好；四是在中文等多字节脚本上收益可能更明显，因为中间 byte 片段更多。当前提供的全文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠复述具体提升幅度、词表规模、阈值设置和不同语料上的 token 数变化，因此不应编造数值。精读时需要重点核对：final exposure 的分布图、不同阈值下 visible/internal 划分比例、编码长度变化、以及 vocabulary-only evaluation 的具体指标和绝对差值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓住两个问题：为什么标准 BPE 会把中间 merge 节点错误地暴露给模型；作者如何在不破坏 merge 树的前提下把这些节点藏起来。阅读顺序上，先看 Introduction 里关于 final exposure 和 Unicode 多字节脚本的动机，再看 Proposed Method 中 internal-only token、resumed training、recursive expansion 这三处机制。然后直接找实验部分里三类图表：1）token exposure 分布；2）pruning threshold 与编码长度/词表利用率的关系；3）vocabulary-only evaluation。若时间有限，预计 20 到 30 分钟可以判断这是不是一个值得在自家 tokenizer pipeline 里复现的小改动。真正值得深挖的点有两个：其一，final exposure 是否足够，还是应该结合 PMI、跨语种覆盖率、embedding 更新频次等更贴近 LM 训练的指标；其二，递归展开后的分词序列是否会改变下游模型对形态边界和多语种字符边界的学习方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a mismatch inside standard BPE: merge learning optimizes for constructing frequent longer units, while the language model only cares about the final emitted tokens. Many learned merge tokens are useful only as intermediate nodes in the merge tree and rarely survive in the fully encoded corpus. Standard BPE still exposes all of them to the model-visible vocabulary, which wastes scarce vocabulary slots on low-exposure tokens that receive little direct training signal. The paper asks a narrower and more practical question than vocabulary compression: with the visible vocabulary size fixed, can we decouple merge construction from model-visible token selection and reallocate those slots to tokens that are actually emitted?
summary_en.importance: This is a tokenizer paper with direct relevance to pretraining efficiency and vocabulary design. Its main contribution is conceptual but practical: BPE merge learning and visible vocabulary exposure do not need to be the same object. That matters because tokenizer choices affect sequence length, embedding utilization, multilingual coverage, and how well token embeddings are trained. The motivation is especially plausible for byte-level BPE on UTF-8 text, where non-Latin scripts can generate many byte fragments that are necessary for building characters or words but are poor model-facing units. If the empirical results hold, the method offers a low-friction improvement path: no change to the LM architecture, no change to the core BPE training loop, only a post-training visibility filter plus slot reallocation. The likely impact is incremental but real, closer to a robust tokenizer engineering improvement than a change in language-model scaling behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages. First, train a standard byte-level BPE tokenizer as usual and keep the full learned merge tree. There is no modification to the merge-learning objective itself. Second, after training, compute each learned token’s final exposure, meaning how often it actually appears in the fully encoded corpus after all merges are applied. Tokens with low final exposure are marked as internal-only: they remain in the merge tree and can still serve as construction nodes for longer tokens, but they are removed from the model-visible vocabulary. Third, to preserve the target visible vocabulary size, the tokenizer training is resumed beyond the original vocabulary budget, producing additional candidate merges. Better-exposed candidates are then used to fill the visible slots vacated by the pruned tokens.

The encoding design is the key implementation detail. Encoding first follows the full merge rules exactly as in standard BPE. If a resulting token is internal-only, it is recursively expanded into visible child tokens until the returned token sequence contains only visible vocabulary items. This preserves the learned merge structure while changing the model interface. The paper is careful to distinguish this from ordinary vocabulary pruning: the visible vocabulary size is preserved, and the merge tree is not discarded. What changes is which learned tokens are exposed to the LM.

This design is more conservative than simply deleting low-frequency tokens, because it does not break the construction path for longer merges. It is also more controlled than retraining a larger tokenizer and truncating it, because it explicitly separates internal merge nodes from model-visible units. A notable part of the paper is the vocabulary-only evaluation under a shared exact minimum-token objective, intended to isolate the effect of visible vocabulary composition from native BPE merge-order artifacts.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the experimental focus is clearly tokenizer-level evaluation rather than end-to-end large-scale LM pretraining. The paper includes a vocabulary-only evaluation with a shared exact minimum-token objective, which is meant to compare standard BPE and Pruned BPE under the same segmentation target and isolate the effect of visible vocabulary composition. The implementation also supports Unicode-aware pretokenization, language/code-friendly boundaries, CPU-parallel training, sharding, and checkpointing, suggesting experiments likely include multilingual or at least non-Latin-script settings.

The important empirical questions are straightforward: how many learned BPE tokens have low final exposure; whether hiding them as internal-only harms encoded sequence length; whether the replacement tokens have materially better exposure in the final corpus; and whether gains are larger for byte-heavy scripts such as Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact numbers for vocabulary size, threshold settings, token-count changes, or downstream gains. When reading the paper, the critical figures to verify are the exposure distribution, the visible/internal split under different thresholds, the effect on encoded length, and the exact margins in the vocabulary-only evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on two ideas: why standard BPE exposes the wrong tokens, and how the paper hides intermediate merge nodes without breaking the merge tree. Start with the motivation around final exposure and UTF-8 byte fragmentation in the introduction. Then read the method section for three mechanisms: internal-only tokens, resumed training beyond the target vocabulary size, and recursive expansion at encoding time. After that, jump to the experiments and look for three things: exposure histograms, the trade-off between pruning threshold and sequence length, and the vocabulary-only evaluation. In about 20 to 30 minutes, you should be able to decide whether this is worth reproducing in a tokenizer pipeline. The deeper questions are whether final exposure is the right criterion by itself, and whether recursive expansion changes the linguistic units the downstream LM ends up learning.

recommendation.zh: 这个点抓得准：BPE 确实把不少词表浪费在“只参与构造、不该暴露给模型”的节点上；建议立刻做 internal ablation，看 token 数下降能否换成真实 pretrain gain。
recommendation.en: This targets a real inefficiency in BPE: too many vocabulary slots are spent on construction-only nodes; worth reproducing internally to see whether shorter sequences translate into actual pretraining gains.

paper.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
paper.abstract: Open-weight language models from different families exhibit complementary capabilities, motivating their consolidation into a compact student through on-policy distillation (OPD). However, full-vocabulary OPD typically assumes a shared tokenizer, while existing cross-tokenizer methods may discard teacher probability mass or assign it to student tokens with unrelated content. We introduce Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM), which re-expresses the teacher's next-token distribution over the student

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是跨 tokenizer 的全词表 on-policy distillation 问题。标准 OPD 在学生生成的轨迹上查询教师，并让学生匹配教师的 next-token 分布，但它默认师生共享 tokenizer。现实中更常见的情况是，Qwen、GLM、MiniMax 等模型族 tokenizer 不同，教师 token 和学生 token 的边界、词表坐标都不一致。已有方法要么只在候选集合上传递一部分概率质量，要么用 rank matching 把概率分给字节内容并不对应的学生 token，要么退化成 sequence-level KD，无法提供密集的 full-vocabulary token-level 监督。论文要构造一个在学生词表上的教师目标分布，同时满足三个条件：覆盖学生词表、按 byte 内容对齐、保留教师概率总质量。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 之间的接口有直接意义。很多团队希望把多个开放模型的能力蒸馏进一个更小的 base 或 reasoning student，但 tokenizer 绑定会限制教师选择。BPM 的贡献不是简单换一个 KD loss，而是给跨 tokenizer 的 dense distribution matching 提供了一个可检查的构造：概率质量在共享 byte 空间中重表达，并显式处理无法匹配的 residual mass。这让 OPD 可以更自由地使用异构教师。另一个有价值的点是它暴露了代码数据里的 tokenizer 伪监督问题：byte-level 对齐过于精确时，可能学到教师 tokenizer 的空白符切分习惯，而不是语义预测行为。这类失败模式对大规模蒸馏 recipe 很实用。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Byte-Prefix Marginalization。给定某个学生前缀位置，先用同一段 byte prefix 对齐教师状态，再取教师的 next-token 分布。对教师词表中的每个 token，取它的 byte 表示，寻找学生词表中 byte 表示是该教师 token byte 前缀的最长学生 token。教师 token 的概率质量被分配给这个学生 token；多个教师 token 映射到同一个学生 token 时做求和。无法找到合法前缀匹配的质量进入显式 residual category。这个 residual 不是实现细节，而是保证 mass preservation 的必要条件，否则目标分布会天然小于 1。论文还处理了 byte prefix 跨越多个教师 token 的位置：在不跨 teacher token 的情况下，BPM 精确恢复教师的 byte-prefix marginal；在跨越情况下，用保质量的 chain-factorized lower bound。训练时仍然是 on-policy：学生生成响应，教师在学生实际访问的状态上给出监督，学生用 generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence 匹配 BPM 变换后的目标。相比 SimCT 这类 candidate-set 方法，BPM 不丢弃未覆盖质量；相比 ULD/GOLD 这类 rank-based 方法，它不把概率分给 byte 内容无关的 token；相比 SeqKD，它保留了 token-level 分布监督。针对代码任务中的空白符问题，论文加入预计算 mask，排除目标完全由 whitespace 组成的位置，避免学生模仿教师 tokenizer 的缩进/空格切分模式。
summary.experiments: 实验把三个异构教师分别蒸馏到同一个 thinking-mode student：Qwen3-32B、GLM-Z1-9B-0414、MiniMax-M2.7。这些教师和学生的 tokenizer 距离不同，用来检验方法对异构 tokenization 的鲁棒性。所有 on-policy 方法使用相同训练预算；SeqKD 按其标准 offline recipe 训练，且没有更小预算的限制。结果上，最佳 BPM 变体在每个 teacher-student pair 上都超过最强基线，分别关闭对应 teacher-student 性能差距的 33.5%、43.9%、34.4%。论文还报告了一个关键统计：超过 99% 的训练位置满足精确恢复 byte-prefix marginal 的条件，说明跨 token spanning 的近似分支在实际训练中占比很低。消融里最有信息量的是代码空白符失败案例：某个师生组合在未屏蔽 whitespace-only target position 时，代码 pass rate 从 49% 降到 9%；加入 whitespace mask 后避免了这种 collapse。这个结果说明跨 tokenizer 蒸馏不能只看分布变换是否形式正确，还要检查 tokenization artifact 是否被当作训练信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法和实验诊断部分。先看引言中 D1/D2/D3 的定义，它把跨 tokenizer full-vocabulary distillation 的要求讲得很清楚，也能帮助判断已有方法为什么不够。随后看 BPM 的构造：最长 byte-prefix 匹配、概率聚合、residual category、spanning position 的 chain factorization。附录里的 Proposition C.3 值得看，它说明什么条件下 BPM 是精确的，以及为什么实验中超过 99% 的位置落在精确情形。实验部分重点看三组教师的主结果表、tokenizer distance 相关分析，以及 Section 4.3 的 whitespace-only mask。最值得深挖的是两个问题：一是 generalized JSD 相比 KL 在 residual mass 存在时的训练稳定性；二是类似 whitespace 的 tokenizer artifact 是否也存在于数学公式、代码标识符、多语言文本和 byte-fallback token 中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses full-vocabulary on-policy distillation when teacher and student models use different tokenizers. Standard OPD queries the teacher on student-generated trajectories and matches the teacher’s next-token distribution, but it assumes aligned token positions and a shared vocabulary. That assumption breaks for heterogeneous model families such as Qwen, GLM, and MiniMax. Existing cross-tokenizer methods either drop unmatched teacher probability mass, assign mass by rank rather than byte content, or avoid dense token-level supervision altogether. The target problem is to build a teacher distribution over the student vocabulary that is complete, byte-aligned, and mass-preserving.
summary_en.importance: The work is practically relevant for consolidating capabilities from multiple open-weight model families into a compact student without being constrained by tokenizer compatibility. Its contribution is not just another distillation loss; it defines a byte-space transformation that makes dense OPD feasible across tokenizers. This matters for pretrain-to-posttrain pipelines where distillation is used to merge reasoning, coding, tool-use, or domain-specific behavior from heterogeneous teachers. The paper also identifies a real training failure in code data: exact byte-level supervision can transfer tokenizer-specific whitespace segmentation instead of useful predictive behavior. That diagnostic is valuable for designing robust large-scale distillation recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Byte-Prefix Marginalization, rewrites the teacher’s next-token distribution in the student vocabulary through a shared byte representation. For each teacher token, BPM takes its byte string and finds the longest student token whose byte string is a prefix of that teacher token’s bytes. The teacher token’s probability is assigned to that student token, and probabilities mapped to the same student token are aggregated. Probability mass that cannot be matched is assigned to an explicit residual category, which is required to preserve total mass. When byte prefixes do not span multiple teacher tokens, the transformed target exactly recovers the teacher’s byte-prefix marginal. At spanning positions, the method uses a mass-preserving chain-factorized lower bound. Training remains on-policy: the student generates trajectories, the teacher is queried at the corresponding byte-aligned states, and the student minimizes a generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence to the transformed target. Compared with candidate-set methods such as SimCT, BPM avoids dropping mass; compared with rank-based methods such as ULD or GOLD, it avoids assigning probability to byte-unrelated student tokens; compared with SeqKD, it keeps dense next-token supervision. A precomputed mask removes all-whitespace target positions in code data to prevent learning tokenizer-specific formatting artifacts.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments distill three heterogeneous teachers into the same thinking-mode student: Qwen3-32B, GLM-Z1-9B-0414, and MiniMax-M2.7. These pairs cover different tokenizer distances. All on-policy baselines use the same training budget, while SeqKD follows its standard offline setup without receiving a smaller budget. The best BPM variant outperforms the strongest baseline for every teacher-student pair, closing 33.5%, 43.9%, and 34.4% of the corresponding teacher-student performance gaps. The paper reports that more than 99% of training positions satisfy the exact byte-prefix marginal condition, so the approximate spanning-position branch is rarely invoked in practice. The most important ablation is the whitespace failure case in code generation: for one teacher-student pair, distilling all-whitespace target positions drops code pass rate from 49% to 9%. Masking those positions prevents the collapse, showing that formally correct byte alignment can still carry harmful tokenizer artifacts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the problem formulation around the D1/D2/D3 criteria first; it cleanly separates vocabulary completeness, byte-level alignment, and mass preservation. Then focus on the BPM construction: longest byte-prefix matching, aggregation, residual mass, and the chain-factorized treatment of spanning positions. Proposition C.3 in the appendix is worth reading because it states when the transformation is exact and explains why the exact case dominates in experiments. In the experiments, prioritize the main teacher-student comparison tables, any tokenizer-distance analysis, and the whitespace-only masking study in Section 4.3. Two details deserve extra scrutiny: how generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence behaves when residual mass is present, and whether similar tokenizer artifacts appear in math notation, multilingual text, byte-fallback tokens, or code identifiers.

recommendation.zh: 这不是小修小补；cross-tokenizer distillation 以前很多做法 target 就不对，建议直接看方法定义和误差分解，内部蒸馏实验应尽快补这个对照。
recommendation.en: This is not a cosmetic tweak: many prior cross-tokenizer distillation setups had the wrong target, so read the method definition and error decomposition and add this control to any internal distillation study.

paper.title: Attacking Graph Foundation Models Through Their Shared Representation
paper.abstract: A graph foundation model generalizes across graph domains by mapping every input into one shared representation before any task reasoning. We call this map the alignment layer, the component that separates a graph foundation model from a graph neural network, and we show it is a distinct attack surface that prior work has not studied. We attack it at inference time, with no access to training, on six public models spanning spectral tokenizers, text embedding spaces, and a discrete codebook. A di

summary.core_problem: 分析 graph foundation models 的 shared representation / alignment layer 是否构成新的推理时攻击面。
summary.importance: 贡献是安全与机制分析，指出图基础模型区别于普通 GNN 的共享表征层可能引入额外脆弱性。它不是 LLM 工作，但对 tokenizer、统一表征和 foundation model attack surface 有一点可迁移的警示。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 alignment layer 为将不同图输入映射到共享表征空间的模块，并在六个公开 graph foundation models 上进行 inference-time attack。攻击包括 representation-space directed perturbation，以及可实现的 input-space attack，如编辑边、特征或文本。
summary.experiments: 覆盖六个公开模型，包含 spectral tokenizer、text embedding space 和 discrete codebook 等不同表征路线。结果称所有模型都会被 directed representation perturbation 击穿；OpenGraph 的 spectral tokenizer 在约普通图网络所需预算五分之一处崩溃，并通过 same-representation control 将脆弱性定位到 tokenizer 而非 decoder。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the shared representation, or alignment layer, in graph foundation models creates a distinct inference-time attack surface.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a security and mechanism analysis showing that shared representation layers can introduce vulnerabilities beyond ordinary GNNs. It is not an LLM paper, but it is relevant as a cautionary example for tokenizers, unified representations, and foundation-model attack surfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define the alignment layer as the module that maps diverse graph inputs into a common representation space, then attack six public graph foundation models at inference time. They use directed representation-space perturbations and realizable input-space edits over edges, features, or text.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans six public models using spectral tokenizers, text embedding spaces, and discrete codebooks. Directed representation perturbations collapse all models; OpenGraph's spectral tokenizer fails at roughly one fifth of the perturbation budget needed by a plain graph network, and same-representation controls trace the fragility to the tokenizer rather than the decoder.

recommendation.zh: 图模型范围太窄，但 OpenGraph tokenizer 脆弱性值得记；做统一 tokenizer 时可当负例。
recommendation.en: The graph setting is narrow, but the OpenGraph tokenizer fragility is worth remembering as a failure case for unified tokenizers.

paper.title: Distributional Matching for Vector Quantization: A Unified Theoretical and Empirical Framework
paper.abstract: The effectiveness of modern visual representation learning and autoregressive models critically depends on vector quantization (VQ), which discretizes continuous feature representations using a learnable codebook. Despite its widespread use, existing VQ methods often suffer from training instability and codebook collapse, arising from gradient mismatch induced by the straight-through estimator and the under-utilization of code vectors. In this work, we show that both issues can be traced to a fu

summary.core_problem: VQ codebook 训练不稳定与 codebook collapse 问题，现有方法受 straight-through estimator 梯度失配与码本利用率低困扰。
summary.importance: 提出从分布匹配角度统一解释 VQ 训练问题的理论框架，给出改善码本利用率和训练稳定性的统一机制，对视觉 tokenizer 与多模态离散表示有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 VQ 的核心问题归因于 encoder feature 分布与 codebook embedding 分布的不匹配，引入分布匹配准则并给出理论分析，用分布对齐统一解释现有改进思路（commitment loss、EMA、codebook reset 等），并提出对应的分布匹配训练目标。
summary.experiments: 在视觉表示学习与自回归视觉建模场景做 VQ 训练对比，报告码本使用率、重构质量、训练稳定性提升；论文摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token 数或与具体 baseline（如 VQ-VAE、VQGAN、RQ-VAE）的定量对比数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Toronto、HKUST、Boston College、Lehigh、SUSTech 等高校，作者列表中 Harry Yang 主要研究方向为生成模型与视觉表征，但非 tokenizer 领域核心团队的旗舰工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Vector quantization suffers from training instability and codebook collapse due to gradient mismatch in the straight-through estimator and low codebook utilization.
summary_en.importance: The paper reframes VQ failures as distributional mismatch between encoder features and codebook vectors, offering a unifying theoretical perspective and a principled training objective that subsumes existing heuristics.
summary_en.technical_approach: It derives criteria for well-behaved VQ and shows that aligning the distributions of encoder outputs and code embeddings mitigates instability and collapse, providing a unified mechanism behind commitment losses, EMA updates, and code resets; a distributional matching objective is proposed.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is conducted on visual representation learning and autoregressive modeling, reporting improved codebook utilization, reconstruction quality, and training stability; the abstract does not specify model sizes, token counts, or head-to-head numbers against VQ-VAE / VQGAN / RQ-VAE baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include University of Toronto, HKUST, Boston College, Lehigh University, and SUSTech; Harry Yang has prior work on generative modeling but this is not a flagship tokenizer paper from a major foundation-model lab.

recommendation.zh: 与文本/多模态 tokenizer 训练痛点相关，但工作落点在 CV 图像 VQ，没有在大尺度或 text/image unified tokenizer 上验证，当 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Relevant to tokenizer stability pains, but validated only in CV image VQ with no large-scale or unified text/image setting; keep as background, don't change any recipe.

paper.title: In-Place Tokenizer Expansion for Pre-trained LLMs
paper.abstract: A tokenizer fixed at the start of pre-training allocates vocabulary in proportion to the pre-training corpus, reflecting the deployment priorities at that time. When those priorities shift, languages added later are split into many more tokens per word, which can raise latency, compute, and energy consumption for users of those languages. Cloud models can afford a broad vocabulary because the embedding and LM-head matrices are a small fraction of their parameters. On a compact model those matric

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是一个很实际的预训练资产迁移问题：模型已经预训练完，tokenizer 却不再适合新的部署语言分布。原 tokenizer 对英语、代码和少数语言压缩较好，但对 Hindi、Vietnamese、Thai 等语言切得很碎，导致同样文本需要更多 decode step。对云端大模型，扩大词表的参数成本通常不敏感；但对端侧模型，embedding / LM head 的词表维度会直接影响显存占用和每 token 解码带宽。因此问题不是简单地“换一个更大的 tokenizer”，而是在不重训模型、不丢掉已有能力、且控制端侧成本的前提下，把 tokenizer 原地扩展到更好的多语覆盖。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把 tokenizer 升级从一个离线 NLP 工具问题，拉回到基座模型持续预训练和部署 recipe 问题。贡献量级主要体现在三个方面。第一，它给出了一条可复用的生产级路线：继续训练 BPE merge，而不是重新训练无关 tokenizer，再用 embedding 初始化和两阶段适配把已有 checkpoint 接上。第二，它明确讨论了端侧模型里的词表大小取舍：更大 vocab 会增加每 token LM-head 成本，但如果能显著减少低资源语言的 token 数，按字符计的解码仍会变快。第三，它把 tokenizer、continued pretraining、mid-training、post-training 连成一条链路，说明 tokenizer 改动不是单点替换，而会固定后续训练阶段的 embedding shape 和模型行为。对预训练研究员来说，这篇论文的启发不在于提出新的 tokenizer 算法，而在于给出了“已训练模型如何安全换词表”的工程化范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 continued-BPE tokenizer expansion。作者从 LFM2 的 65K byte-level BPE tokenizer 出发，保持已有 merge 不变，在一个偏向欠覆盖语言、同时保留英语和代码的多语语料上继续学习新的 BPE merge，把词表扩展到 128K。这样做有两个关键性质：多数旧 token 在新词表中仍然是一对一 token；所有新 token 都可以精确分解成旧 tokenizer 下的一串 source tokens。相比重新训练一个独立 tokenizer，这种构造避免了任意 source-to-target token 对齐问题；相比简单 vocabulary union，它保持了 BPE merge 结构上的连续性，也更适合模型参数迁移。模型侧初始化也利用这两个性质：保留下来的旧 token 直接复制 embedding / LM-head row；新 token 的 row 用其旧 token 分解的 embedding 均值初始化。随后做两阶段适配：第一阶段只训练 embedding，冻结模型主体，让新词表先对齐已有表示空间；第二阶段全模型 continued pretraining，用均衡多语 mixture 让模型主体适应新的分词边界。完成 tokenizer adaptation 后，再进入常规 mid-training 和 SFT 等后训练阶段，得到 LFM2.5-8B-A1B。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 LFM2-8B-A1B checkpoint，一个面向端侧的 8B 参数 MoE 模型。词表从约 65K 扩到 128K，其中 64,400 个 source tokens 里有 63,151 个在 expanded tokenizer 中仍作为单 token 保留，可直接复制参数。token 压缩收益很明显：同一文本下，expanded tokenizer 对 Hindi 的 token 数约减少 2.4 倍，对 Vietnamese 约减少 2.6 倍，对 Thai 最大约减少 4.0 倍。作者还把 tokenizer 压缩收益和更大词表带来的每 token 成本分开测量，估计在参考端侧设备上，这些语言按字符计的 decode speedup 约为 2.2–3.7 倍。材料中提到 Section 6 证明该适配 recipe 不牺牲已有质量，Section 8 讨论负结果，但当前给出的正文片段没有展开具体 benchmark 分数、训练 token 数、消融表格或失败方案细节。能确认的关键消融方向包括：embedding-only warmup 是否必要、新 token 初始化方式是否稳定、continued-BPE 是否优于独立 tokenizer 或简单并词表，以及扩大词表的 per-token latency penalty 是否会抵消 token compression。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Figure 1、Section 2、Section 3、Section 6、Section 7 和 Section 8。Figure 1 把整个 pipeline 讲清楚：continued BPE 构造、embedding 初始化、embedding-only 训练、full CPT、再接 mid-training 和 post-training。Section 2 的重点是为什么继续 BPE merge，而不是重训 tokenizer 或做 vocabulary union；这里决定了后续参数迁移是否简单。Section 3 应重点看新 token row 如何用 source-token decomposition 初始化，以及 tied / untied embedding 和 LM head 是否有不同处理。Section 6 应重点看质量保持的证据，尤其是旧语言、代码、英语能力有没有回退，以及新语言增益来自 tokenizer 压缩还是 continued pretraining 数据。Section 7 值得细看，因为它把词表扩大带来的每 token 成本和 token 数减少带来的总收益拆开，这是端侧 LLM tokenizer 设计里很容易被忽略的点。Section 8 的负结果尤其重要，通常比正向 recipe 更能说明哪些看似简单的迁移方法不稳定。
summary.authors_note: Liquid AI 团队；工作背景是 LFM2 到 LFM2.5 系列端侧 MoE 模型的 tokenizer 扩展和 continued pretraining 实践。材料中未给出具体作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete checkpoint-migration problem: a model has already been pretrained, but its tokenizer no longer matches the deployment language mix. The original LFM2 tokenizer is compact and efficient for English, code, and a fixed set of languages, but it fragments languages such as Hindi, Vietnamese, and Thai into many more tokens. That directly increases decoding steps. For on-device models, increasing the vocabulary is not free, because the embedding and LM-head matrices affect memory footprint and per-token decode bandwidth. The problem is therefore how to expand the tokenizer in place, improve multilingual compression, and preserve the accumulated quality of the pretrained checkpoint without restarting pretraining.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a production-scale recipe for tokenizer evolution after pretraining. It treats tokenizer replacement as part of continued pretraining, not as a standalone preprocessing change. The contribution is practical but important: continue the existing BPE merge process, preserve a mostly one-to-one mapping for old tokens, initialize new rows from old-token decompositions, and adapt the model in two stages. This is directly relevant to foundation-model maintenance, especially when deployment priorities change after the original pretraining run. It also gives a useful latency framing for edge models: a larger vocabulary increases per-token cost, but better compression can still reduce per-character decoding time when the old tokenizer was severely fragmented.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach is continued-BPE tokenizer expansion. Starting from the 65K byte-level BPE tokenizer used by LFM2, the authors keep the existing merges fixed and append new merges learned on a multilingual corpus weighted toward under-tokenized languages, while retaining English and code to avoid losing compression on existing workloads. The expanded tokenizer has a 128K vocabulary. This construction gives two useful mapping properties: most old tokens survive as single tokens in the new vocabulary, and every newly added token has an exact decomposition into a sequence of old tokens. The model initialization follows this structure. Rows corresponding to carried-over tokens are copied directly. Rows for new tokens are initialized as the mean of the embeddings of their old-token decomposition. Adaptation then proceeds in two stages: first, train only the embedding-related parameters while freezing the model body; second, run full-model continued pretraining on a balanced multilingual mixture. After this tokenizer adaptation, the model enters the usual mid-training and supervised post-training pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The recipe is applied to an LFM2-8B-A1B checkpoint, described as an 8B-parameter on-device MoE model. The vocabulary is expanded from roughly 65K to 128K. Out of 64,400 source tokens, 63,151 remain single tokens in the expanded vocabulary, enabling direct row copying. The tokenizer compression gains are large for the target languages: about 2.4x fewer tokens for Hindi, 2.6x fewer for Vietnamese, and up to 4.0x fewer for Thai on the same text. After accounting for the higher per-token cost of the larger vocabulary, the authors estimate a 2.2–3.7x per-character decode speedup on the reference devices for these languages. The provided excerpt states that Section 6 shows no sacrifice of accumulated quality and that Section 8 reports negative findings, but it does not include the detailed benchmark tables, training-token counts, or ablation numbers. The most important experimental questions to check in the full paper are the necessity of embedding-only adaptation, the robustness of mean initialization, old-language regression, and whether the latency gains survive on real edge hardware.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Figure 1 first; it captures the full pipeline from tokenizer construction to model adaptation and later training stages. Then focus on Section 2 for the continued-BPE construction and why it is preferable to an independently trained target tokenizer or a simple vocabulary union. Section 3 should contain the key model-side initialization details, especially how new embedding and LM-head rows are handled. Section 6 is the quality-preservation section and should be read carefully for regressions on English, code, and previously supported languages. Section 7 is important for deployment researchers because it separates token-count reduction from the per-token cost of a larger vocabulary. Section 8 is likely the highest-yield part after the main recipe, since failed alternatives often reveal the stability constraints of tokenizer migration.
summary_en.authors_note: Liquid AI team; the work is tied to the LFM2/LFM2.5 on-device MoE model line and its tokenizer expansion during continued pretraining. The provided material does not list individual authors.

recommendation.zh: 这是少见的“可逆兼容”的 tokenizer 升级方案，直接影响多语扩展与端侧带宽；优先读方法与对照实验，确认是否真能免大规模再训。
recommendation.en: A rare tokenizer-upgrade recipe with invertible backward compatibility; read the method and ablations to see if it truly avoids large-scale retraining while improving tokens-per-word and on-device bandwidth.
