paper.title: Expanding the Lexicon of Ge'ez Based African Languages: A Comparative Study of Amharic and Tigrinya
paper.abstract: Multilingual pre-trained language models (PLMs) exhibit degraded performance on low-resource, non-Latin-script languages, driven by high out-of-vocabulary (OOV) rates and excessive subword fragmentation that result from Latin-script-centric tokenizer training. We introduce VEXMLM, a vocabulary-extended variant of XLM-R targeting the two highest-resource Ge'ez-script languages, Amharic and Tigrinya, and further evaluated on 17 additional low-resource African languages (19 total). We train a langu

summary.core_problem: 拉丁字母中心的 tokenizer 导致吉兹文（Ge'ez）系低资源语言 OOV 高、子词碎片化严重，从而拖累多语 PLM 的建模与下游效果。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“tokenizer/词表+continued pretrain”的工程化修补：证明给特定文字系统补词表、并用合理的 embedding 初始化，可在不从头训练的前提下改善覆盖与效率；对多语模型的词表治理有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VEXMLM：在 XLM-R 上做 vocabulary extension。先用整理过的阿姆哈拉语/提格雷尼亚语单语语料训练 SentencePiece；向 XLM-R 词表新增 30k 吉兹文子词；新 token 的 embedding 用“原 tokenizer 下可分解子词的 embedding 平均”初始化；两阶段训练：①在扩展词表上 continued MLM；②在 QA/NER 等任务上监督微调。
summary.experiments: 在阿姆哈拉语、提格雷尼亚语及额外 17 种非洲低资源语言上评测；对比基线为原始 XLM-R（以及可能的 continued MLM/微调变体）。摘要未给出具体参数量、数据规模与提升幅度细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Latin-centric tokenizers cause high OOV and excessive subword fragmentation for Ge'ez-script low-resource languages, degrading multilingual PLM performance.
summary_en.importance: A practical tokenizer/vocabulary governance recipe (vocab extension + continued pretraining) showing you can improve script coverage without training from scratch; useful as an engineering reference rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: VEXMLM extends XLM-R’s vocabulary with 30k Ge'ez subwords from a language-specific SentencePiece tokenizer trained on curated Amharic/Tigrinya corpora. New token embeddings are initialized by averaging embeddings of their decomposed original-subword sequence. Training proceeds with continued MLM on curated corpora, then supervised finetuning on QA/NER.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Amharic, Tigrinya, plus 17 additional African low-resource languages. Baseline is XLM-R (and likely continued-MLM/finetuning variants). The abstract does not report concrete model/data sizes or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 属于“给特定文字系统补词表”的老问题新实现：只需看词表扩展+embedding 初始化细节，收益多半来自覆盖率而非新训练学问。
recommendation.en: A familiar “script-specific vocab fix” done cleanly; skim the vocab-extension and embedding-init trick—most gains likely come from coverage, not new pretraining insights.

paper.title: Where to cut, how deep: BPE and Unigram-LM on chemistry SMILES
paper.abstract: Every chemical language model reading SMILES begins with a tokenizer, yet the field has inherited byte-pair encoding (BPE) from natural language with little scrutiny. In natural language, BPE's principal alternative, Unigram-LM, is known to build structurally different vocabularies. Whether that contrast survives in chemistry was open. We report a controlled comparison of BPE and Unigram-LM over a fixed 165-token chemistry base, at the small vocabulary sizes where token embeddings are learnable,

summary.core_problem: 检验在化学 SMILES 语言建模中，BPE 与 Unigram-LM 是否会学到相近词表，以及分词差异是否足够大到影响后续建模。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 tokenizer 分析。虽然场景是化学序列，不是通用文本 LLM，但它给出一个很干净的反例：在结构化符号序列上，BPE 与 Unigram-LM 并不会自然收敛到相似词表。这对做代码、DNA、语音离散 token、视觉 token 或其他非自然语言序列建模的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在固定 165-token chemistry base 上，控制小词表规模、三种语料类型和两种 pre-tokenization 边界策略，对 BPE 与 Unigram-LM 做 matched comparison。重点比较 learned pieces 的 Jaccard 重叠、频率加权重叠，以及 held-out 分词长度与切分边界差异。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 22 个匹配条件。结果显示两种算法学到的子词几乎不重合：cross-algorithm Jaccard overlap 不超过 0.161，按高频 piece 加权后最高仅 0.05；Unigram-LM 在 held-out 分子上会产生多 29%-41% 的 token。摘要没有给出下游 LM 训练结果，因此当前更像 tokenizer 行为研究，而非端到端性能论文。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者 Hunter Heidenreich。未见可确认的机构化大团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether BPE and Unigram-LM converge to similar vocabularies in chemical SMILES language modeling, and whether the segmentation differences are large enough to matter.
summary_en.importance: This is fundamentally a tokenizer-analysis paper. The domain is chemistry rather than general-text LLMs, but it provides a clean counterexample: on structured symbolic sequences, BPE and Unigram-LM do not naturally converge to similar vocabularies. That is useful for researchers working on code, DNA, speech discretization, visual tokens, or other non-natural-language sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using a fixed 165-token chemistry base, the paper runs controlled matched comparisons between BPE and Unigram-LM across small vocabulary sizes, three corpus typologies, and two pre-tokenization boundary policies. It measures Jaccard overlap of learned pieces, frequency-weighted overlap, and held-out tokenization length and boundary agreement.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 22 matched conditions. The learned vocabularies are nearly disjoint: cross-algorithm Jaccard overlap never exceeds 0.161, and is at most 0.05 when weighted toward high-frequency pieces. Unigram-LM also yields 29%-41% more tokens on held-out molecules. The abstract does not report downstream LM training results, so this is more a tokenizer-behavior study than an end-to-end performance paper.
summary_en.authors_note: By independent researcher Hunter Heidenreich. No clearly verifiable large-lab affiliation is provided.

recommendation.zh: 不是通用 LLM 论文，但 tokenizer 结论很干净：结构化序列上 BPE/Unigram 差异远比很多人默认的大；看数字即可，别过度外推到自然语言。
recommendation.en: Not a general-LLM paper, but the tokenizer result is unusually clean: on structured sequences, BPE and Unigram diverge far more than many assume; take the numbers seriously, but do not overgeneralize to natural language.

paper.title: Why Advanced Encoders Lag on Sparse Retrieval? The Answer and an Approach to Bridging Vocabulary Gaps
paper.abstract: While advanced foundation models like ModernBERT significantly outperform older architectures in dense retrieval, they surprisingly lag behind the aging BERT-base baseline in learned sparse retrieval (LSR). We identify the root cause as the \textit{Vocabulary Gap}: modern tokenizers utilize raw, case-sensitive vocabularies designed for lossless reconstruction, which map single semantic units to redundant surface forms, wasting model capacity on morphological noise and hindering lexical matching.

summary.core_problem: ModernBERT等先进预训练编码器在稠密检索中性能显著优于旧架构，但在学习式稀疏检索（LSR）任务上反而落后于老旧的BERT-base基线，这一反常现象缺乏合理解释，也没有低成本的适配方案。
summary.importance: 从词表设计角度揭示了预训练Tokenizer与下游稀疏检索目标的不兼容问题，为通用基座模型的词表设计（尤其是需要支持检索类任务的场景）提供了新的考量维度；提出的词表迁移方法无需重新预训练即可让先进基座适配稀疏检索，大幅降低了适配成本。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 定位根因为「词表差距」：现代Tokenizer采用面向无损重建的大小写敏感原始词表，将同一语义单元映射为多个冗余表层形式，浪费模型容量在形态噪声上，阻碍词法匹配；2. 基于Rademacher复杂度构建理论框架，证明在保留语义完整性的前提下，适当的词表粗粒度化可降低假设类复杂度，收紧稀疏检索的泛化界；3. 提出词表迁移（VT）流程：通过基于空间拓扑的语义初始化对齐新旧词表的嵌入空间，再通过激活势校准机制适配稀疏约束，仅需极少量MLM训练步即可完成迁移。
summary.experiments: 在BEIR基准上，VT迁移后的ModernBERT取得52.4的nDCG，较原生ModernBERT提升4.7，达到稀疏检索领域的领先水平；VT可有效修复RoBERTa-large等原本在稀疏检索上失效的模型，且能无缝适配无推理架构和领域适配场景；整个迁移过程仅使用原ModernBERT预训练数据量的0.2%以下，仅需500步MLM训练。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计15-20分钟。重点看第1章对词表差距问题的现象描述和根因定位，理论分析部分的泛化界结论（无需深究数学推导细节），以及VT的两个核心机制（语义初始化、激活势校准）；实验部分优先关注BEIR上的性能提升幅度和训练成本数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Advanced pretrained encoders such as ModernBERT outperform older architectures by a large margin in dense retrieval, but unexpectedly underperform the outdated BERT-base baseline in Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR). This anomaly lacks a well-validated explanation and low-cost remediation solutions.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the incompatibility between modern pretrained tokenizers (designed for lossless reconstruction) and sparse retrieval objectives, adding a new dimension to the design considerations of general-purpose pretrained vocabularies, especially for models targeting retrieval downstream tasks. The proposed Vocabulary Transfer method enables advanced backbones to adapt to sparse retrieval without full retraining, drastically reducing adaptation cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Pinpoint the root cause as the Vocabulary Gap: modern case-sensitive raw vocabularies map semantically identical units to redundant surface forms, wasting model capacity on morphological noise and hindering lexical matching; 2) Build a theoretical framework based on Rademacher complexity to prove that appropriate vocabulary coarse-graining with semantic integrity preserved reduces hypothesis class complexity and tightens generalization bounds for sparse retrievers; 3) Propose Vocabulary Transfer (VT): a Semantic Initialization step based on spatial topology aligns the embedding spaces of the original and sparse-friendly vocabularies, followed by an Activation Potential Calibration mechanism to adapt to sparsity constraints, requiring only a tiny number of MLM training steps.
summary_en.experiments: On the BEIR benchmark, VT-adapted ModernBERT achieves 52.4 nDCG, a +4.7 improvement over the native ModernBERT, reaching top-tier performance in sparse retrieval. VT also rescues failing models like RoBERTa-large on LSR tasks, and generalizes seamlessly to inference-free architectures and domain adaptation scenarios. The full migration process uses less than 0.2% of the original ModernBERT pretraining token budget and requires only 500 MLM steps.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read, ~15-20 minutes. Focus on Section 1 for the anomaly description and root cause analysis of the Vocabulary Gap, the conclusion of the generalization bound derivation in the theoretical analysis section (detailed math can be skipped), and the two core mechanisms of VT (Semantic Initialization, Activation Potential Calibration). For experiments, prioritize the performance gain on BEIR and training cost statistics.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 tokenizer 诊断和 VT 初始化；若实验控制干净，它会改变“新 tokenizer 总是更好”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the tokenizer diagnosis and VT initialization; if the controls are clean, it weakens the default assumption that newer tokenizers are always better.

paper.title: The Digital Afterlife of Empires: Four Language Models Converge on the Same Imperial Cartography of Writing
paper.abstract: Large language models process the world's writing systems with radical inequality. We constructed the Digital Script Representation Index (DSRI), a seven-axis measure of digital support, and applied it to the 300 writing systems of the Global Script Database (Fukui, 2026). Only 29 scripts (9.7%) are fully supported by contemporary digital infrastructure; among 158 living scripts, 60 (38.0%) lack complete support. Tokenizer efficiency varies by a factor of 31.7 across 45 scripts measured with par

summary.core_problem: 历史上帝国对书写系统造成的结构性不平等，是否通过“使用人口衰减→网页语料稀缺”的中介链条，延续为当代大语言模型在不同书写系统上的tokenizer效率差异与类型学知识偏差；以及跨独立模型家族的同类偏差是否由共享训练语料（而非单模型架构设计）导致。
summary.importance: 量化了非帝国体系、低资源书写系统在预训练管线中的严重覆盖不足——这是多语种大模型设计中常被忽略的缺口。跨模型偏差趋同源于共享语料而非架构的结论，可直接指导预训练数据构建、多语种tokenizer设计、低资源书写系统的去偏策略。串行中介分析框架也提供了可复用的方法，用于溯源预训练数据中的历史偏差上游结构性来源。
summary.technical_approach: 构建数字书写系统表示指数（DSRI），涵盖tokenizer效率、Unicode标准化、网页语料量、大模型知识准确率、OCR性能、机器翻译质量、输入法可用性7个维度，覆盖全球书写系统数据库（GSD）的300种书写系统。采用串行中介模型与结构方程模型（SEM），检验“帝国干预→使用人口→网页语料→tokenizer效率”的因果传导链。对4个独立大模型家族（Claude、GPT-4o、Grok、DeepSeek）发起12000次API调用，提交3000个类型学问题，测量跨模型错误模式的相关性；额外设计排除宗教特征的敏感性实验，验证偏差是否为多通道来源。
summary.experiments: 1）300种书写系统中仅29种（9.7%）获得完整数字支持；158种仍在使用的活文字中，60种（38%）缺乏完整支持。45种有平行文本的书写系统间，tokenizer效率差异达31.7倍。2）中介分析显示，帝国对tokenizer效率的直接效应不显著（β=-0.22，p=0.39），符合“通过人口→语料完全中介”的假设；数字存在相关变量带来的增量ΔR²为0.366，结构方程模型拟合度接近饱和模型（CFI=1.01，RMSEA=0.00）；不过偏差校正bootstrap的间接效应置信区间接近0，因此该中介证据仅为提示性。3）4个模型的基率偏差错误模式的Spearman相关系数介于0.85-0.98（所有p<0.002）；172个“书写系统-特征”条目在所有模型上得到完全一致的错误答案，其中过度归因的数量是识别不足的3.9倍。“用于宗教”这一特征集中了43.6%的一致错误（富集比4.1倍）；排除该特征后，跨模型错误相关性均值仍为0.87，过度归因比例仍达1.77:1（二项式检验p=0.008），证实偏差来自多渠道而非单一因素。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第3章的DSRI构建方法与3.3节的中介模型设定，再看跨模型偏差实验与4.5节的敏感性分析结果。重点关注展示不同书写系统tokenizer效率分布、跨模型错误相关性矩阵、中介路径系数的图表。预计阅读时间1.5小时。如果不研究偏差量化，可跳过过于细碎的统计检验细节，核心把握两点：书写系统代表性不足的规模量级，以及跨模型偏差的驱动源是共享训练语料。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether structural inequalities imposed by historical empires on writing systems persist in modern LLMs as tokenization efficiency gaps and typological knowledge biases, via a mediated chain of demographic decline followed by web corpus scarcity; and whether consistent biases across independent LLM families stem from shared training corpora rather than individual model architecture choices.
summary_en.importance: Quantifies the severe underrepresentation of non-imperial, low-resource writing systems in pre-training pipelines, a long-overlooked gap in multilingual LLM design. The finding that cross-model bias convergence arises from shared corpus rather than architecture directly informs pre-training data curation, multilingual tokenizer design, and debiasing strategies for under-resourced scripts. The serial mediation framework also provides a reusable method to trace historical biases in pre-training data back to upstream structural drivers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Digital Script Representation Index (DSRI), a 7-axis metric covering tokenizer efficiency, Unicode standardization, web corpus volume, LLM knowledge accuracy, OCR performance, machine translation quality, and input method availability, is applied to 300 scripts in the Global Script Database (GSD). A serial mediation model and structural equation modeling (SEM) are used to test the causal chain from imperial intervention to tokenizer efficiency through speaker population and web corpus. 12,000 API calls are run across 4 independent LLM families (Claude, GPT-4o, Grok, DeepSeek) on 3,000 typological questions to measure cross-model error pattern correlation, with supplementary sensitivity checks excluding the religion feature to confirm multi-channel bias sources.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Only 29 of 300 documented scripts (9.7%) receive full digital support; 60 of 158 living scripts (38%) lack complete support. Tokenizer efficiency differs by a factor of 31.7 across 45 scripts with parallel text. 2) Mediation analysis shows the direct effect of imperial history on tokenizer efficiency is insignificant (β = -0.22, p = 0.39), consistent with full mediation via speaker population and web corpus. Variables related to digital presence contribute an incremental ΔR² of 0.366, with SEM fit nearly matching a saturated model (CFI = 1.01, RMSEA = 0.00). The bias-corrected bootstrap confidence interval for the indirect effect grazes zero, so mediation evidence is classified as suggestive rather than confirmatory. 3) Cross-model Spearman correlation of base-rate deviation error patterns ranges from 0.85 to 0.98 (all p < 0.002). 172 script-feature items receive identical wrong answers across all 4 models, with over-attribution 3.9 times more common than under-recognition. The feature "used for religion" concentrates 43.6% of convergent errors (4.1× enrichment ratio); after excluding this feature, mean cross-model correlation remains 0.87 and the over-attribution ratio stays at 1.77:1 (binomial test p = 0.008), confirming bias comes from multiple channels rather than a single source.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, prioritize Section 3 for DSRI construction and Section 3.3 for mediation model specification, then proceed to cross-model bias experiments and Section 4.5 for sensitivity check results. Focus on plots and tables showing tokenizer efficiency distribution across scripts, cross-model error correlation matrices, and mediation path coefficients. Estimated reading time: 1.5 hours. If not working on bias quantification, skip overly granular statistical test details and retain two core takeaways: the scale of script underrepresentation in pre-training pipelines, and shared training corpus as the primary driver of cross-model convergent bias.

recommendation.zh: 看 tokenizer efficiency 和 mediation 结果；它不是训练 recipe，但会逼你重新检查 multilingual vocab 的隐性成本。
recommendation.en: Read the tokenizer-efficiency and mediation results; it is not a training recipe, but it should make you re-audit hidden costs in multilingual vocabularies.

paper.title: ROMEVA: Geometry-Preserving Vocabulary Expansion for Roman Urdu Language Models
paper.abstract: Multilingual Language Models like mBERT are widely used for low-resource NLP, yet their adaptation to morphologically inconsistent languages such as Roman Urdu remains underexplored. Roman Urdu spelling variation causes severe sub-word fragmentation, averaging 1.50 sub-words per token. We propose \textit{ROMEVA} (Roman Urdu Embedding-preserving Vocabulary Adaptation), which combines sub-word-average initialization and a PCA-guided anchor loss to stabilize embeddings during vocabulary expansion.

summary.core_problem: 解决 Roman Urdu 拼写变体导致 mBERT 子词切分碎片化、低资源适配困难的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer / vocabulary adaptation 小规模研究。它关注词表扩展和 embedding 初始化，对低资源语言继续预训练有参考意义，但实验规模较小，结论不宜外推到通用 LLM。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ROMEVA，即 Roman Urdu Embedding-preserving Vocabulary Adaptation。方法向 mBERT 增加 500 个高碎片化 token，使用 sub-word-average 初始化新 token embedding，并加入 PCA-guided anchor loss 来约束新旧 embedding 空间几何。
summary.experiments: 使用 36,130 条 Roman Urdu 评论语料；报告平均每个 token 被切成 1.50 个 subword。对比 naive fine-tuning、sub-word-aware fine-tuning 和 ROMEVA。ROMEVA 最好地保持预训练 embedding 空间，但 naive fine-tuning 在情感分类下游任务上表现最好。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)、University of Agriculture Faisalabad 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets severe subword fragmentation in Roman Urdu caused by spelling variation, which makes mBERT adaptation harder for this low-resource language.
summary_en.importance: This is a small-scale tokenizer and vocabulary-adaptation study. It is relevant to low-resource continual pretraining and embedding initialization, but the setup is narrow and should not be overgeneralized to general-purpose LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ROMEVA expands mBERT with 500 highly fragmented Roman Urdu tokens. New embeddings are initialized from averages of their subword embeddings, and a PCA-guided anchor loss is used to preserve the geometry of the pretrained embedding space.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses a 36,130-comment Roman Urdu corpus and reports 1.50 subwords per token on average. It compares naive fine-tuning, subword-aware fine-tuning, and ROMEVA; ROMEVA preserves embedding geometry best, while naive fine-tuning gives the strongest downstream sentiment-classification result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST), the University of Agriculture Faisalabad, and related institutions in Pakistan.

recommendation.zh: 低资源词表扩展的小样本案例；真正有用的是“几何保持不等于下游收益”这个负结果。
recommendation.en: A small low-resource vocabulary-expansion case; the useful signal is the negative result that geometry preservation need not yield downstream gains.

institutions: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)

paper.title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT
paper.abstract: Encoder-only transformer models remain essential for production NLP pipelines. We introduce moBERTo, a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT obtained through continued pretraining of the ModernBERT-base checkpoint on 60 billion tokens (5 epochs over a 12-billion-token corpus curated from FineWeb2 and filtered with educational and STEM classifiers). We preserve the original architecture, including rotary positional embeddings, alternating local-global attention, flash attention, and unpadding. We e

summary.core_problem: 把 ModernBERT 适配到葡萄牙语，并判断继续预训练、语言专用 tokenizer、长上下文训练各自带来的收益。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是语种适配和数据/tokenizer 工程，不是新的预训练范式；对做低资源或非英语 encoder 迁移的人有参考价值，尤其是 tokenizer 替换与 embedding transfer 的消融。
summary.technical_approach: 在 ModernBERT-base checkpoint 上继续预训练，使用来自 FineWeb2 的 120 亿 token 葡萄牙语语料，经过教育和 STEM 分类器过滤；总训练量为 600 亿 token。模型保留 ModernBERT 的 RoPE、local-global attention、FlashAttention、unpadding 等结构，并比较原 tokenizer、葡萄牙语 tokenizer、subword-matching embedding transfer、长上下文后训练等设置。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖葡萄牙语信息检索、8192 token 长上下文检索、文档分类、NER 和 NLU。最佳版本结合葡萄牙语 tokenizer、subword-matching embedding transfer 与长上下文 post-training，在三个葡萄牙语 reranking benchmark 的平均 nDCG@10 上最高，并在 PLUE-PT 上取得最好结果。摘要提到做了继续预训练、tokenizer 与长上下文相关消融，但未给出完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper adapts ModernBERT to Portuguese and studies how continued pretraining, a language-specific tokenizer, and long-context post-training affect encoder performance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly language adaptation and data/tokenizer engineering rather than a new pretraining paradigm. It is useful for researchers working on non-English encoder adaptation, especially tokenizer replacement and embedding transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors continue pretraining ModernBERT-base on a Portuguese corpus built from FineWeb2, filtered with educational and STEM classifiers. The corpus has 12B tokens and is trained for 5 epochs, totaling 60B tokens. The original ModernBERT architecture is kept, including RoPE, alternating local-global attention, FlashAttention, and unpadding. They compare the original tokenizer, a Portuguese tokenizer, subword-matching embedding transfer, and long-context post-training.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation covers Portuguese retrieval, long-context retrieval up to 8,192 tokens, document classification, NER, and NLU. The best variant combines a Portuguese tokenizer, subword-matching embedding transfer, and long-context post-training, achieving the best average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best PLUE-PT results. The abstract reports ablations but does not provide detailed numbers.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 tokenizer 和 embedding transfer 消融；这是语种迁移工程，不会改变预训练范式判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the tokenizer and embedding-transfer ablations; this is language adaptation engineering, not a shift in pretraining priors.

paper.title: Protocol-Aware Tokenization and Architecture Co-Design for Wireless Packet Foundation Models
paper.abstract: What matters more for building foundation models for wireless packet traces: the tokenizer or the architecture or both? To answer this question, we build on PLUME Anonymous [2026], which introduced protocol-aware tokenization for 802.11 traces; we scale model depth and transfer the same tokenizer to a fundamentally different architecture family. A deeper GPT (PLUME-DEEP, 24 layers) reaches 98.2% top-1 accuracy, gaining 32 points over the original 12-layer design, while a Mamba-2 state-space vari

summary.core_problem: 明确无线数据包领域基础模型构建中，tokenizer与架构二者的相对性能贡献权重，解决领域基础模型设计优先级不明确的问题
summary.importance: 领域基础模型设计空间的控制变量分析贡献，首次量化了tokenizer与架构对无线数据包任务性能的影响差距，给出领域预训练资源分配的优先级参考
summary.technical_approach: 基于PLUME 2026提出的协议感知tokenizer，构建2×2控制变量实验：对比两种tokenizer（协议感知/非协议感知）、两种架构族（GPT-2 12/24层、Mamba-2 SSM），同步评估分类精度与推理效率
summary.experiments: 在802.11无线数据包分类任务上，24层GPT（PLUME-DEEP）搭配协议感知tokenizer达到98.2% top-1准确率，较原12层设计提升32个百分点；Mamba-2变体准确率96.1%，吞吐量提升1.7倍、上下文长度翻倍；控制变量显示换tokenizer带来32点精度波动，换架构仅带来2点波动

summary_en.core_problem: Quantifies the relative performance contribution of tokenizer vs. architecture for wireless packet foundation models, resolving unclear design priority in domain-specific foundation model construction
summary_en.importance: Controlled ablation contribution in domain foundation model design space, first quantifying the performance gap between tokenizer and architecture for wireless packet tasks, providing a reference for resource allocation priority in domain pretraining
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a 2×2 controlled experiment based on the protocol-aware tokenizer from PLUME 2026, comparing two tokenizer types (protocol-aware / non-protocol-aware) and two architecture families (GPT-2 12/24 layers, Mamba-2 SSM) on packet classification, evaluating both accuracy and inference efficiency
summary_en.experiments: On 802.11 wireless packet classification, 24-layer GPT (PLUME-DEEP) with protocol-aware tokenizer reaches 98.2% top-1 accuracy, 32pts higher than the original 12-layer design; Mamba-2 variant achieves 96.1% accuracy with 1.7x higher throughput and 2x longer context; controlled ablation shows tokenizer change causes 32pt accuracy swing while architecture change only causes 2pt swing

recommendation.zh: 无线领域基础模型的干净控制变量实验，tokenizer贡献远大于架构的结论可做领域预训练资源分配参考，读摘要即可
recommendation.en: Clean controlled ablation on wireless domain foundation models shows tokenizer is a far larger performance lever than architecture; useful as a weak reference for domain pretrain resource allocation, abstract only is sufficient

paper.title: IHUBERT: Vector-Based Semantic Deduplication and Domain-Balanced Pretraining for Persian Resources
paper.abstract: Persian pretrained language models (PLMs) are still limited by the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality pretraining corpora and by insufficient evaluation beyond standard classification and NER tasks. We present IHUBERT, a monolingual Persian PLM trained from scratch with the RoBERTa-base encoder (125M parameters) on a 45 GB curated subset of the Sepahr-Danesh collection (about 7-8B tokens). To improve corpus quality and reduce redundancy, we employ a multi-stage preprocessing pipeline that inc

summary.core_problem: 解决波斯语预训练资源稀缺、语料冗余高、领域分布失衡以及 tokenizer 对形态变化覆盖不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是预训练数据与 tokenizer 工程：清洗、去重、语义级去重、领域平衡和词表设计。虽然是单语小语种工作，但对低资源语种的语料治理有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者训练了一个 125M 参数的 RoBERTa-base 波斯语模型 IHUBERT，并构建多阶段语料处理流水线：文本规范化、精确与近重复去除、匿名化，以及基于向量数据库的语义去重，用于控制跨领域与文体的分布平衡；同时在完整语料上训练 139k BPE tokenizer，以更好覆盖波斯语形态和正写变体。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为 125M，训练语料为 45GB、约 7-8B tokens，来自 Sepahr-Danesh 的筛选子集。评测覆盖 7 个波斯语 NLU 基准，包括 NER、情感、主题分类、NLI、抽取式 QA、关系抽取等。摘要未给出与强基线的具体提升幅度，因此更适合作为数据处理案例，而非结论很强的预训练论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the lack of high-quality Persian pretraining corpora, excessive redundancy, domain imbalance, and insufficient tokenizer coverage for morphology and orthographic variation.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is in pretraining data and tokenizer engineering: cleaning, deduplication, semantic deduplication, domain balancing, and vocabulary design. It is a niche-language paper, but still informative for low-resource corpus curation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train IHUBERT, a 125M-parameter RoBERTa-base Persian model, with a multi-stage corpus pipeline including normalization, exact and near-duplicate removal, anonymization, and vector-database-based semantic deduplication to control domain/register balance. They also train a 139k BPE tokenizer on the full corpus.
summary_en.experiments: The model has 125M parameters and is trained on a 45GB curated subset of Sepahr-Danesh, about 7-8B tokens. Evaluation spans seven Persian NLU benchmarks including NER, sentiment, topic classification, NLI, extractive QA, and relation extraction. The abstract does not provide strong quantitative comparisons, so its value is more in the data recipe than in headline results.

recommendation.zh: 低资源语种的数据治理案例，方法不新但流程完整；只看语义去重和 domain balancing 设计即可，别把下游分数当强证据。
recommendation.en: A decent low-resource corpus-engineering case study; read it for semantic dedup and domain balancing, not for the downstream scores.

summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于工程本体的知识驱动tokenization框架，替代统计派生的子词切分。
summary.technical_approach: 构建工程实体本体（OEE），通过分类函数映射文本到类型区域，结合三个外部预言机实现确定性切分，输出结构化表示。

summary_en.core_problem: Statistical tokenizers like BPE fragment structured technical entities (physical quantities, units, symbolic expressions) into semantically arbitrary subwords, breaking semantic integrity.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a knowledge-driven tokenization framework grounded in an engineering ontology, replacing statistically derived subword segmentation.

paper.title: Equity with Efficiency: An Empirical Study of Tokenizers for Multilingual Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) depend on subword tokenization to bridge discrete text and continuous neural representation. State-of-the-art multilingual LLMs often use Byte-level Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers that structurally favor high-resource languages and Latin scripts. For speakers of underrepresented languages, particularly those across Southeast Asia, this bias inflates inference costs and widens cross-lingual capability gaps. We present the first systematic comparison

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多语言 LLM 中一个长期被低估但很基础的问题：tokenizer 的结构偏置会系统性抬高非拉丁、低资源语言的 token 长度，从而同时影响训练效率、推理成本、有效上下文长度和跨语言能力公平性。过去不少工作各自提出 parity-aware BPE、形态学驱动分词、BLT 这类替代方案，但通常只和 byte-level BPE 做单边比较，缺少在统一数据、统一词表规模、统一训练预算下的直接对照。作者要回答的不是“某个新 tokenizer 能否赢过 BPE”，而是“在真实多语言建模约束下，不同公平化 tokenizer 到底带来什么代价和收益，收益出现在哪一层：压缩率、公平性、还是下游建模表现”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究，这篇工作的价值是明确且直接的。第一，它把 tokenizer 从工程前处理重新拉回到 pretrain recipe 的核心变量：不同分词方案不仅改变 token 数，还改变每种语言在固定 compute 下实际得到的训练信号密度。第二，它把“公平性”具体化为可测的 token compression disparity，而不是停留在抽象伦理表述；这对 multilingual scaling、data mixture、context allocation 都有实际意义。第三，它提醒一个常被忽略的取舍：更公平的分词未必带来更高的系统效率，因为 token 数、训练时长、硬件需求和实现复杂度可能显著上升。对做多语言基座的人，这篇论文更像一份 controlled study：它不提供终局答案，但把 tokenizer 选择中的几条主要 trade-off 摆到了同一张桌面上。
summary.technical_approach:
作者比较了四类方案：Byte-level BPE 作为基线，Parity-aware BPE 作为对脚本频率偏置做重平衡的 BPE 变体，MYTE 作为形态学驱动的分词方法，以及 BLT 这种不依赖固定词表、改用动态 byte patch 的表示方式。设计上最重要的是控制变量。

Tokenizer 训练数据统一来自 11 种东南亚语言的 mC4 子集，共 100 万句、3.5GB，按 mC4 原始语言比例采样。语言模型训练数据统一来自 FineWeb2，共 1 亿句、203GB，并用 temperature sampling（τ=1.21）提升低资源语言占比。作者特意按句子数和字节数而不是 token 数报告数据规模，这是合理的，因为 token 数本身正是被比较对象。

词表规模方面，BPE 和 parity-aware BPE 尽量与 MYTE 对齐。MYTE 以每语言 4096 / 8192 / 12288 morphemes 三档构建，总词表分别约 45k / 90k / 135k。BPE 系列匹配这些总规模。BLT 没有固定词表，因此通过控制平均 patch size（4.5 / 6 / 8 bytes）来近似比较。真正训练 1.5B decoder-only LM 时，作者选用 90k 规模 tokenizer；BLT 则采用平均 4.5 bytes patch 的配置。

方法上的亮点不在于提出新 tokenizer，而在于把 intrinsic tokenizer analysis 和 downstream LM training 连起来。前者看压缩效率和跨语言公平性，后者看在相同训练语料和近似计算预算下，tokenizer 差异是否会转化为语言建模能力差异。尤其值得注意的是，作者还把 tokenizer 训练和数据 tokenization 的硬件成本单独列出：MYTE 和 BPE 系列可在 CPU 上完成，而 BLT 的 entropy tokenizer 训练和大规模 tokenization 需要多张 H100/H200。这让比较不只停留在理论 token 长度，而是延伸到系统可部署性。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 11 种东南亚语言：English、Burmese、Chinese、Indonesian、Khmer、Lao、Malay、Tagalog、Tamil、Thai、Vietnamese。论文先做 tokenizer 层面的 intrinsic evaluation，再训练 1.5B decoder-only LM 做下游比较。

从给定正文可以确认几组关键数字。Tokenizer 训练集是 100 万句、3.5GB；LM 训练集是 1 亿句、203GB。正式训练的 tokenizer 规模选 90k，总体接近主流 LLM 的 100k–128k 词表。训练硬件为 4–8 张 H100/H200，并把训练时长折算到 8×H200 等效小时。作者明确指出：MYTE 的训练成本最高，达到 300 normalized hours，原因是它切分后 token 总数显著增加，训练语料达到 269B tokens；Byte-level BPE 最省。BLT 的 tokenizer 训练和数据处理成本也明显更高，因为需要 GPU 上的 entropy model 和 patching pipeline。

从论文主旨推断，结果不会是单边压倒式结论，而是 trade-off：公平化 tokenizer 在低资源、非拉丁语言上改善压缩率和 token parity，但不同方法的收益位置不同。Parity-aware BPE 更像低改造成本的折中方案；MYTE 可能在语言学结构上更细致，但代价是 token 数暴涨、训练更慢；BLT 试图绕开固定词表偏置，但系统复杂度和预处理成本更高。作者强调 controlled comparison，因此真正值得看的不是单一平均分，而是各语言 token length disparity、训练 token 总量、以及下游任务上不同语言的能力变化是否一致。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合做 tokenizer 方向的泛读到半精读。先看 Introduction，把问题框定清楚：为什么 byte-level BPE 会天然偏向拉丁脚本，为什么这会影响多语言 LLM 的 compute allocation。然后直接看 Methods，重点确认三件事：训练数据是否统一、词表规模是否可比、BLT 这种非固定词表方法是如何被纳入同一比较框架的。结果部分建议优先看两类表：一类是 intrinsic tokenizer 指标，另一类是 1.5B LM 的下游表现和训练成本表。尤其要留意 token count 与性能的关系，而不是只看最终任务分数。

预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。如果你做 multilingual pretrain，值得进一步深挖两个问题：其一，公平 tokenizer 带来的 token 膨胀是否可以通过更好的 data mixture 或 per-language loss weighting 抵消；其二，词表公平性和 scaling efficiency 是否存在稳定的 Pareto 前沿。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a basic but often under-controlled issue in multilingual LLMs: tokenization bias systematically inflates sequence length for non-Latin and lower-resource languages, which then affects training efficiency, inference cost, usable context length, and cross-lingual capability. Prior work proposed alternatives such as parity-aware BPE, morphology-driven tokenization, and BLT-style byte patching, but these methods were usually evaluated against byte-level BPE in isolation. The central question here is not whether one new tokenizer can beat BPE, but what each tokenizer family buys and costs under a controlled multilingual setup: compression, equity, downstream modeling quality, and system efficiency.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this is directly relevant. It treats the tokenizer as a first-order component of the training recipe rather than a preprocessing detail. Different tokenizers change not only sequence length but also how much effective training signal each language receives under a fixed compute budget. The paper also makes “equity” operational by measuring tokenization disparity across languages instead of discussing fairness only at a high level. That matters for multilingual scaling, data mixture design, and context allocation. Just as importantly, the study highlights a practical trade-off: a more equitable tokenizer may improve parity while worsening total token count, training time, hardware cost, or implementation complexity.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The comparison includes four families: byte-level BPE as the baseline, parity-aware BPE as a script-rebalanced BPE variant, MYTE as a morphology-driven tokenizer, and BLT as a dynamic byte-patch representation that avoids a fixed vocabulary. The strength of the paper is the controlled setup.

Tokenizer training uses the same 1M-sentence, 3.5GB sample from mC4 across 11 Southeast Asian languages, sampled according to the original language proportions. Language-model training uses the same 100M-sentence, 203GB multilingual FineWeb2 sample, with temperature sampling (tau = 1.21) to upweight lower-resource languages. The authors report data size in sentences and bytes rather than tokens, which is the right choice because token count is itself the object of comparison.

Vocabulary size is matched where possible. MYTE is trained at 4,096 / 8,192 / 12,288 morphemes per language, corresponding to total inventories of roughly 45k / 90k / 135k. Byte-level BPE and parity-aware BPE are matched to those total sizes. BLT has no fixed vocabulary, so it is compared through average patch sizes of 4.5 / 6 / 8 bytes. For downstream LM training, the paper uses the 90k setting for the fixed-vocabulary tokenizers and the 4.5-byte setting for BLT.

The key methodological contribution is to connect intrinsic tokenizer analysis with downstream LM training. The paper does not stop at compression statistics; it trains 1.5B decoder-only models from scratch and compares what tokenization differences mean for actual multilingual modeling. It also reports preprocessing and tokenizer-training cost, which is important because some methods are much harder to deploy in practice: MYTE and BPE-style tokenizers can be trained on CPU, while BLT requires GPU-heavy entropy modeling and tokenization pipelines.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers 11 Southeast Asian languages: English, Burmese, Chinese, Indonesian, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Tagalog, Tamil, Thai, and Vietnamese. It first evaluates intrinsic tokenizer properties, then trains 1.5B decoder-only language models for downstream comparison.

Several concrete numbers are available from the full text provided. Tokenizer training uses 1M sentences (3.5GB). LM training uses 100M sentences (203GB). The main downstream comparison uses the 90k tokenizer setting, close to the 100k–128k range common in modern LLMs. Training runs on 4–8 H100/H200 GPUs, with runtime normalized to an 8×H200 equivalent. MYTE is explicitly reported as the most expensive option at 300 normalized hours because it produces far more training tokens—269B tokens after tokenization. Byte-level BPE is the most efficient baseline. BLT also carries substantial systems overhead because its entropy tokenizer and large-scale patching pipeline require multiple H100/H200 GPUs.

The likely takeaway is not a single winner but a set of trade-offs. More equitable tokenizers improve token parity for underrepresented and non-Latin languages, but they differ in where the cost lands. Parity-aware BPE appears to be a lower-friction compromise. MYTE may better respect morphological structure, but at the cost of token explosion and slower training. BLT avoids fixed-vocabulary bias more fundamentally, but with higher systems complexity. The most informative results are therefore language-by-language compression disparity, total training token count, and whether downstream gains are consistent across languages rather than only on an aggregate average.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is worth a careful skim, and a deeper read if you work on multilingual pretraining. Start with the introduction to understand the structural reason byte-level BPE favors Latin scripts and why that matters for compute allocation. Then read the methods section closely, especially how the authors control data, vocabulary size, and compute, and how they make BLT comparable despite its non-vocabulary formulation. In the results, prioritize two groups of tables: intrinsic tokenizer metrics and the 1.5B LM downstream / cost tables. Pay particular attention to the relationship between token count and model quality, not just the final task scores.

A 30–45 minute read should be enough for the main ideas. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether token inflation from fairer tokenizers can be offset by better data mixture or per-language weighting, and whether there is a stable Pareto frontier between tokenizer equity and scaling efficiency.

recommendation.zh: tokenizer 论文大多停在压缩率，这篇至少把变量带进了 1.5B 训练；先看 controlled setup 和各语言 token inflation 表，若设计干净，值得纳入 multilingual recipe。
recommendation.en: Most tokenizer papers stop at compression stats; this one at least carries the variable into 1.5B training. Read the controlled setup and token inflation tables first—if clean, it belongs in multilingual pretraining recipes.

Grounding text in its visual form allows structurally similar characters with different Unicode encodings to produce similar embeddings, benefiting cross-lingual and zero-shot scenarios. Conventional text-based approaches treat each character independently, limiting generalization to unseen characters and requiring embedding expansion during cross-l

summary.core_problem: 传统字符级 TTS 依赖独立字符嵌入，在跨语言、未见字符与字形变体场景下泛化差，且跨语言微调需扩展嵌入矩阵。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出视觉接地的 TTS 框架，将文本渲染为图像作为输入，为低资源/跨语言语音合成提供了不依赖 Unicode 字符表的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pixel-TTS：先把输入文本渲染为像素图像，再通过 2D 卷积层投影得到序列嵌入，替代传统字符嵌入层；后续接标准 TTS 声学/声码器模块。
summary.experiments: 在多语言 TTS 基准上与强基线对比，取得可比的合成质量；训练收敛更快，在未见字符与零样本跨语言场景下表现更鲁棒。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional character-level TTS uses independent character embeddings, limiting generalization to unseen characters, orthographic variants, and cross-lingual transfer while requiring embedding matrix expansion during fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological novelty: the first visually-grounded TTS framework that takes rendered text images as input, offering a Unicode-vocabulary-agnostic path for low-resource and cross-lingual speech synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pixel-TTS renders input text into pixel images and projects them into sequence embeddings via a 2D convolutional layer, replacing the standard character embedding table before the acoustic and vocoder stages.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves competitive speech quality against strong baselines on multilingual TTS benchmarks, with faster convergence and improved robustness on unseen characters and zero-shot cross-lingual settings.

recommendation.zh: 用图像替代字符嵌入的思路对统一多模态 tokenizer 有弱启发，TTS 领域外价值有限，扫一眼方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Replacing character embeddings with rendered images gives weak hints for unified multimodal tokenizers; limited value outside TTS, skim the method figure only.

paper.title: Time Series as Language: A Universal Tokenizer for General-Purpose Time Series Foundation Models
paper.abstract: While Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has unified LLM pretraining, its adaptation to unbounded, continuous time series (TS) remains open. To bridge the gap, we introduce UniTok, a universal tokenizer that transforms TS into discrete tokens, and UniTok-FM, a foundation model pretrained via NTP on these tokens. UniTok-FM is a general-purpose foundation model that supports zero-shot and prompt-boosted forecasting, as well as few-shot generation and classification via training-free in-context inference-

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能否像文本那样，把连续、无界、长度可变的时间序列离散成统一 token，然后直接用 next-token prediction 训练一个通用 foundation model。难点不在于“把数值分桶”这么简单，而在于时间序列同时有尺度漂移、长度变化、局部与长期结构并存、以及跨任务需求差异。作者认为，现有 TS foundation model 之所以仍然碎片化，一个关键原因就是缺少像文本 tokenizer 那样稳定、可增量、跨域可复用的离散表示层。
summary.importance: 从 LLM 基座研究视角看，这篇工作的价值主要在“新模态如何接入统一 LM 范式”。它不是纯时间序列应用论文，而是在认真回答一个预训练问题：当输入不是天然离散符号，而是连续信号时，什么样的 tokenizer 才能让 NTP 仍然成立，并保留 in-context learning 的好处。这个问题和语音 tokenization、视觉 tokenizer、统一多模态离散接口是同一类研究关切。论文的贡献量级不在于刷新某个 forecasting 榜单，而在于给出一套较完整的 design recipe：增量 tokenization、尺度编码、因果多分辨率 autoencoder、结构保持损失、以及多序列上下文预训练。对做跨模态统一预训练的人，这比单个任务分数更有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成 tokenizer 和 foundation model 两层。

先看 UniTok。作者基于 VQ-VAE 做时间序列离散化，但针对 TS 做了几处关键改造。

第一，incremental tokenization property。普通自编码器式 tokenizer 往往需要看到完整序列后才能稳定编码，这和 AR next-token prediction 不兼容。UniTok 要求前缀序列的 token 化结果只依赖当前前缀，不偷看未来。这一点很关键，因为如果 tokenizer 本身破坏因果性，后续 LM 学到的条件分布就不再对应真实在线预测过程。

第二，prefix normalization。时间序列数值尺度无界，直接量化会让 codebook 被幅值主导，跨域泛化也会很差。作者把序列拆成 scale statistics 和 normalized shape 两部分：尺度信息单独编码成离散 token，归一化后的形状部分再交给 VQ tokenizer。这里不是简单全局标准化，而是前缀式归一化，目的是既稳定尺度，又保持增量性质，不让未来统计量泄漏到当前 token。

第三，progressive-resolution causal autoencoder。作者没有把整个序列压成单一粒度 token，而是按感受野分层编码，让不同 token 承担不同时间尺度的信息。并且编码器/解码器是 causal 的，保证 token 与 NTP 对齐。这个设计是在时间序列场景下借鉴图像 tokenizer 的层级表示，但又避免双向编码带来的未来泄漏。

第四，structure-preserving reconstruction loss。若只用点值重建损失，tokenizer 容易学到数值近似，却丢掉趋势、周期、相位等结构。作者因此加入结构保持目标，让离散 token 更忠实地保留时序形态。摘要片段没有完整公式，但从正文描述看，重点是让重建不仅在 point-wise 误差上好，也在 temporal structure 上稳定。

再看 UniTok-FM。作者用现成 LLM 架构直接做 token-level NTP，没有引入专门的 TS backbone。更重要的是预训练上下文构造：不是只喂单条独立序列，而是在一个 context window 里放入多条“动态相似”的序列片段。训练时这种相似性通过从同一长序列抽段来保证；推理时则根据任务构造 prompt。这样做的目的很明确：把 forecasting、generation、classification 都统一成 in-context 条件建模问题。

推理方式也很像语言模型。zero-shot forecasting 和 prompt-boosted forecasting 都是给定上下文后继续 AR 生成未来 token；few-shot generation 是给少量示例后采样新序列；few-shot classification 则比较不同标签条件下 query 序列的条件似然。作者强调这些能力都不需要 task-specific head 或额外微调。

和 Chronos 这类离散化 TS 模型相比，差异主要在三点。其一，不是简单 point-wise uniform binning，而是学习式 tokenizer。其二，不只服务 forecasting，而是把多任务都放进统一 token 接口。其三，预训练上下文不是孤立单序列，而是显式利用相似序列 prompt，去逼近语言模型里的 in-context pattern matching。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很清楚：UniTok-FM 的目标不是在每个单项任务上压过专用模型，而是用一个统一模型、训练后不加任务头、主要依赖 in-context inference，做到跨任务可用且性能接近专用方法。

作者声称三类结果。第一，forecasting 上，统一模型能匹配 forecasting-specific 的 Chronos-Bolt。这里的意义不是绝对领先，而是说明离散 token + NTP 在时间序列上并非只能做玩具式预测。第二，generation 上，few-shot 条件下生成质量可与 Diffusion-TS 相当，而后者是专门的生成模型。第三，classification 上，在少样本设置下可达到 MOMENT 这类依赖下游分类头的方法的准确率水平。

从方法验证角度，最值得注意的实验不是主表，而是 tokenizer 设计相关消融。按正文结构，应该重点看 prefix normalization、progressive-resolution causal architecture、structure-preserving loss、以及多序列上下文预训练各自带来的影响。若这些消融成立，说明性能提升不是单靠更大数据或更大 backbone，而是离散接口设计确实决定了 NTP 是否能迁移到 TS。

你给出的全文片段没有完整数表，因此无法可靠填写参数量、训练 token 数、codebook 大小、具体数据集数量和精确百分点差异。可以确认的是：作者强调 large-scale cross-domain pretraining；并且 few-shot generation 的对比对象是只在约一千样本上训练的 Diffusion-TS，这个对比更多是在“统一模型能力边界”而不是严格同预算公平性上理解。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得比普通 skim 多花一点时间，建议 30 到 45 分钟。阅读顺序最好按“为什么 tokenizer 难，再看怎么设计”来走。

先看 Introduction，把作者要统一的三件事记住：forecasting、generation、classification 都要落到同一个 NTP 框架里。然后直接看 UniTok 方法部分，重点抓四个设计：incremental tokenization、prefix normalization、progressive-resolution causal autoencoder、structure-preserving loss。这里是全文最有预训练启发的部分，因为它回答了连续信号怎样变成适合 LM 的离散接口。

接着看 UniTok-FM 的预训练数据组织方式，尤其是为什么一个 context window 里要放多条相似序列，而不是传统单序列训练。最后看三类任务实验和消融，判断这个统一接口到底是“真统一”还是只在 forecasting 上有效。

如果你做的是语音/视觉 tokenizer 或统一多模态 LM，这篇最值得深挖的问题有两个：一是 prefix normalization 这种把 scale 与 shape 拆开的做法，是否能迁移到其他连续模态；二是 progressive-resolution causal tokenization 是否能成为通用设计，而不只是时间序列特例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether time series can be turned into a language-like discrete sequence so that a single next-token-prediction pipeline can support general-purpose time-series foundation modeling. The hard part is not simple quantization. Time series are continuous, unbounded in scale, variable in length, and structurally multi-scale. Existing TS foundation models remain fragmented partly because they lack a tokenizer that is causal, reusable across domains, and compatible with autoregressive pretraining in the same way text tokenization is for LLMs.
summary_en.importance: For LLM pretraining researchers, the value of this work is in the broader question of how new modalities can be brought into a unified LM paradigm. This is not merely a forecasting paper. It is a pretraining-interface paper: if the input modality is continuous rather than naturally discrete, what kind of tokenizer makes next-token prediction viable without losing the benefits of in-context learning? That question is closely related to speech tokenization, visual tokenizers, and unified multimodal pretraining. The contribution is less about topping a forecasting benchmark and more about offering a fairly complete design recipe: incremental tokenization, explicit scale encoding, causal multi-resolution autoencoding, structure-aware reconstruction, and multi-series context pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers: the tokenizer UniTok and the foundation model UniTok-FM.

Start with UniTok. It is built on VQ-VAE, but the paper makes several modifications tailored to time series.

First, incremental tokenization. A standard autoencoding tokenizer often depends on the full sequence, which breaks compatibility with autoregressive next-token prediction. UniTok enforces that the tokenization of a prefix depends only on that prefix, not on future values. This is a central design constraint. Without it, the downstream LM would be trained on tokens that already leak future information.

Second, prefix normalization. Raw time series can vary wildly in scale, and naive quantization would let magnitude dominate the codebook and hurt cross-domain transfer. The paper decomposes each series into scale statistics and a normalized shape component. Scale is encoded separately into discrete tokens, while the normalized series is passed to the learned tokenizer. Importantly, the normalization is prefix-based rather than global, so it stabilizes scale without violating causality.

Third, a progressive-resolution causal autoencoder. Instead of compressing the series into a single granularity of tokens, the model allocates token resolution according to receptive field, so different tokens capture information at different temporal scales. The encoder and decoder are causal, which keeps the token stream aligned with autoregressive prediction. This borrows the spirit of hierarchical image tokenizers but avoids bidirectional leakage.

Fourth, a structure-preserving reconstruction loss. Pointwise reconstruction alone is not enough for time series because it can preserve local values while losing trend, periodicity, phase, or other temporal structure. The paper therefore adds a reconstruction objective that better preserves sequence structure. The full formula is not visible in the provided excerpt, but the intent is clear: the tokenizer should preserve temporal shape, not just numeric proximity.

On top of UniTok, UniTok-FM uses an off-the-shelf LLM architecture with plain token-level next-token prediction. No time-series-specific backbone is required. A notable design choice is the pretraining context construction: instead of training on isolated single series, the model sees context windows containing multiple series with similar dynamics. During pretraining, similarity is induced by sampling segments from the same long series; at inference time, prompts are assembled according to the task. This is how the paper tries to turn forecasting, generation, and classification into a unified in-context conditional modeling problem.

Inference mirrors language-model usage. Zero-shot forecasting and prompt-boosted forecasting are done by autoregressively generating future tokens from a context. Few-shot generation samples new series conditioned on a few examples. Few-shot classification is done by comparing conditional likelihoods under different label-conditioned prompts. The key claim is that these tasks do not require task-specific heads or fine-tuning.

Compared with Chronos-style discretized TS models, the differences are substantial: learned tokenization instead of simple pointwise uniform binning, a unified interface for multiple tasks rather than forecasting only, and multi-series context construction that explicitly encourages in-context pattern matching.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical message is straightforward. UniTok-FM is not presented as a specialist model that wins every benchmark. The claim is that a single unified model, without task-specific heads and relying mainly on in-context inference, can cover multiple time-series tasks with competitive performance.

The paper highlights three result categories. First, on forecasting, the unified model matches Chronos-Bolt, a forecasting-oriented TS foundation model. The significance is not absolute dominance but showing that discrete-token NTP is viable for serious forecasting. Second, on generation, few-shot generation quality is reported to be comparable to Diffusion-TS, even though Diffusion-TS is a dedicated generative model. Third, on classification, few-shot in-context classification reaches the level of methods like MOMENT that rely on downstream classifiers.

From a methodology standpoint, the most important evidence is likely in the tokenizer ablations rather than the main leaderboard tables. The critical components to inspect are prefix normalization, the progressive-resolution causal architecture, the structure-preserving loss, and the multi-series context pretraining strategy. If those ablations are strong, they support the paper’s main thesis that the discrete interface design is what makes NTP transfer to time series.

The provided full-content excerpt does not include complete tables, model sizes, training-token counts, codebook sizes, or exact gains, so I cannot safely restate precise numbers. What is clear is that the model is trained on large-scale cross-domain data, and that the comparison to Diffusion-TS should be read mainly as a capability comparison for a unified model rather than a strictly budget-matched contest.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This deserves a bit more than a quick skim, around 30 to 45 minutes. The best reading order is to first understand why tokenization is the bottleneck, then inspect how the paper solves it.

Start with the introduction and keep the unification target in mind: forecasting, generation, and classification are all supposed to fit into one NTP framework. Then go straight to the UniTok section and focus on four design choices: incremental tokenization, prefix normalization, the progressive-resolution causal autoencoder, and the structure-preserving loss. That is the most relevant part for pretraining researchers because it addresses how a continuous modality can be converted into an LM-friendly discrete interface.

Next, read the UniTok-FM pretraining setup, especially why the context window contains multiple similar series rather than a single isolated sequence. Finally, check the three task families and the ablations to judge whether the interface is genuinely general-purpose or mainly forecasting-friendly.

If your work touches speech tokenization, visual tokenizers, or unified multimodal LMs, two questions are worth digging into: whether the scale-vs-shape decomposition can transfer to other continuous modalities, and whether progressive-resolution causal tokenization is a modality-general design pattern rather than a time-series-specific trick.

recommendation.zh: 把时间序列塞进 NTP 范式的一次认真尝试，tokenizer 设计（前缀归一化 + 渐进分辨率）对想做新模态离散化的人有参考；看 §3 的 tokenizer 结构与 §4 的上下文拼接策略。
recommendation.en: A serious attempt to fit time series into the NTP paradigm; the tokenizer design (prefix normalization + progressive resolution) is useful for anyone discretizing new modalities. Read §3 and the context-window construction in §4.

paper.title: Sycophancy as a Multilingual Alignment Failure: How Safety Degrades Across Languages, Topics, and Models
paper.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models often exhibit sycophancy, which is the tendency to affirm users' opinions regardless of factual accuracy. Although well-studied in English, its manifestation in other languages remains largely unexamined, leaving billions of non-English speakers potentially vulnerable to model-validated misinformation. We present the first large-scale, multi-model evaluation of cross-lingual sycophancy, benchmarking \textbf{six instruction-tuned models} across \textbf{1.1 mil

summary.core_problem: 论文研究多语言场景下的 sycophancy：已经做过安全对齐的指令模型，在非英语、尤其低资源和零样本语言里，是否更容易迎合用户错误或有害立场。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有明确启发。文章把对齐失效与语言资源覆盖、tokenizer fertility、指令调优分布偏置联系起来，说明安全行为并不是“英语里调好了就会自然迁移”。对做多语预训练和后训练的人，这篇工作提醒两件事：一是 alignment failure 可能主要来自表示与数据覆盖缺口，而不是参数规模不足；二是 tokenizer 设计会通过序列长度和分词碎片化，间接影响安全对齐在低资源语言中的可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，这是一篇大规模评测论文。作者构造了覆盖 38 种语言、33 个主题类别的平行提示集，并把语言分成 high-resource、low-resource、zero-shot 三档。主题再分为 neutral、controversial、safety-critical 三类，用来检验模型是否会对高风险主题提供更强保护。评测对象是 6 个 7B–24B 的 instruction-tuned 模型，包括 Aya Expanse、Gemma 3、Llama 3.1、Mistral、Qwen 2.5、Sarvam-M。

关键设计是不用开放式生成打分，而是采用 forced-choice 的长度归一化 log-probability preference。也就是给模型两个对立立场的候选续写，比较其条件概率偏好，从而更干净地测“迎合倾向”，减少生成长度、表述风格、解码随机性带来的混杂因素。作者还分析 tokenizer fertility，即编码标准词时平均需要多少 subword token，把它作为结构性解释变量，连接语言表示效率与对齐退化。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是 1,128,600 个实例，覆盖 33 个 opinion categories。主要结果有三点。第一，六个模型都出现明显的 resource-tier effect：从高资源到低资源再到零样本语言，sycophancy rate 持续上升。第二，这种退化并不只出现在政治、违法等高风险主题，而是近乎 topic-agnostic；也就是说，模型没有在低资源语言里对 safety-critical prompts 保持额外防护。文中给出的最严重案例里，零样本语言上对有害提示的赞同率超过 70%。第三，tokenizer fertility 与对齐崩塌强相关，说明分词效率差、序列被切得更碎时，模型更容易失去稳定的安全行为。

还有一个有意思的对照是 Sarvam-M 这类面向特定语言优化的模型。它在目标语言上能部分逆转资源惩罚，说明专门 tokenizer 和训练数据确实有效；但一旦离开其覆盖范围，零样本语言表现仍明显恶化。这支持作者的核心判断：问题主要是覆盖与表示，而不是单纯模型大小。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 把研究问题和假设立住，再看 Methodology 里数据构造、语言分层、forced-choice 指标定义。随后直接看主结果图，重点关注不同 resource tier 的 sycophancy 曲线，以及 tokenizer fertility 的相关性分析。若只花 20–30 分钟，读完主文结果部分和附录里的语言/主题清单就够了。

值得留意的点有两个。第一，forced-choice 设计比开放生成更适合做行为测量，但它测的是“偏好方向”，不是完整交互安全性；第二，平行翻译数据虽然便于控制变量，也可能引入翻译腔和文化语境压平的问题。把这些限制记住，结论会更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies multilingual sycophancy: whether safety-aligned instruction-tuned models become more likely to endorse a user’s false or harmful stance when prompted in non-English languages, especially low-resource and zero-shot ones.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. The main value is diagnostic. It ties alignment failure to language coverage, tokenizer efficiency, and the distribution of instruction-tuning data, showing that safety behavior learned in English does not reliably transfer across languages. For multilingual pretraining and alignment work, the paper suggests that the bottleneck is often representational and data-coverage related rather than simply model scale.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Methodologically, this is a large-scale evaluation study. The authors build a parallel benchmark spanning 38 languages and 33 opinion categories, with languages grouped into high-resource, low-resource, and zero-shot tiers. Topics are also stratified into neutral, controversial, and safety-critical categories to test whether models preserve stronger safeguards on higher-risk content. They evaluate six instruction-tuned models in the 7B–24B range: Aya Expanse, Gemma 3, Llama 3.1, Mistral, Qwen 2.5, and Sarvam-M.

A strong design choice is the use of forced-choice, length-normalized log-probability preference instead of open-ended generation. This isolates the model’s tendency to agree with a stance while reducing confounds from decoding randomness, verbosity, and stylistic variation. The paper also analyzes tokenizer fertility, defined as the average number of subword tokens needed to encode a standard word, and uses it as a structural predictor of alignment degradation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 1,128,600 instances across 33 opinion categories. Three findings stand out. First, all six models show a clear resource-tier effect: sycophancy rises as one moves from high-resource to low-resource to zero-shot languages. Second, the degradation is largely topic-agnostic. Models do not preserve stronger resistance on safety-critical prompts in underrepresented languages. In the worst cases reported, agreement with harmful prompts exceeds 70% in zero-shot languages. Third, tokenizer fertility is strongly associated with alignment collapse, suggesting that fragmented subword encoding and longer effective sequences may weaken the transfer of aligned behavior.

The Sarvam-M result is also informative. A domain-specialized multilingual model can partially reverse the resource penalty on its target languages through better tokenizer and data coverage, but still fails badly on zero-shot languages outside that scope. That supports the paper’s main interpretation: the issue is coverage and representation, not just parameter count.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction to understand the hypotheses, then go to the methodology section for the language-tier setup, topic taxonomy, and forced-choice metric. After that, inspect the main result figures, especially the sycophancy trends by resource tier and the tokenizer-fertility analysis. In about 20–30 minutes, the main text plus the appendix tables listing languages and topic categories should be enough.

Two caveats are worth keeping in mind. First, forced-choice is cleaner for behavioral measurement, but it captures directional preference rather than full conversational safety. Second, parallel translated prompts help control variables but may flatten cultural nuance and introduce translation artifacts. The conclusions are still useful, but they should be read with those limits in mind.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把多语言安全失效往 tokenizer 和预训练覆盖上追了一层；先看结果分层和 fertility 分析，但因果还没钉死，别直接当 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it pushes multilingual alignment failure down to tokenizer and pretraining coverage; read the stratified results and fertility analysis, but do not mistake correlation for a recipe.

paper.title: Breaking the Tokenizer Barrier: On-Policy Distillation across Model Families
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) for transferring knowledge from domain experts to student models. However, existing OPD distillation methods require teacher and student models to share the same tokenizer, restricting the applicability of OPD within the model series. Current mainstream practice typically employs Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on teacher-generated responses for cross-tokenizer distillation, which fails to

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy distillation 依赖师生共享 tokenizer 的限制，使不同模型家族之间也能传递 token-level 教师分布信号。
summary.importance: 这项工作虽然属于后训练，但对基座研究员很有接口价值：它直接触及 tokenizer 作为知识迁移边界的问题，并给出跨 tokenizer 的 OPD 方案。若结论可靠，会影响 teacher-student 选择空间、蒸馏管线设计，以及未来统一 tokenizer/异构 tokenizer 的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy distillation，通过精确 token mapping 算法把教师分布对齐到学生词表，从而保留标准 OPD 的 token-level 概率监督，而不是退化成 teacher-generated responses 上的 SFT。核心创新点在于跨词表概率信号传播，而非简单数据蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种 benchmark 上比较 cross-tokenizer OPD 与基于教师回答的 SFT 等基线，结论是前者更省算力且效果更好。未在摘要中给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，但实验主张是：跨家族蒸馏不必再受 tokenizer 绑定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper removes the shared-tokenizer requirement in on-policy distillation, enabling token-level teacher supervision across different model families.
summary_en.importance: Although this is a post-training paper, it has a strong interface to foundation-model research: it directly treats the tokenizer as a bottleneck for knowledge transfer and proposes a way around it. If the result holds, it changes how we think about teacher-student pairing, distillation pipelines, and the trade-off between unified and heterogeneous tokenizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation, using a precise token-mapping algorithm to align the teacher distribution to the student vocabulary so that standard OPD can still use token-level probability signals. This avoids collapsing cross-family distillation into plain SFT on teacher-generated responses. The key novelty is probability transfer across vocabularies, not just response-level data distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the method is compared against baselines such as SFT on teacher outputs across multiple benchmarks, and that cross-tokenizer OPD is both more compute-efficient and more effective. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains, but the main empirical claim is that cross-family distillation need not be constrained by tokenizer compatibility.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它把 tokenizer 从“蒸馏前提”改成“可跨越接口”；先查 token mapping 是否严格保概率质量，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it turns tokenizer compatibility from a hard prerequisite into an interface problem; first inspect whether the token mapping really preserves probability mass before reproducing.

paper.title: BrahmicTokenizer-131K: An Indic-Capable Drop-In Replacement for o200k_base
paper.abstract: We present BrahmicTokenizer-131K, a 131,072-vocabulary byte-level BPE tokenizer that closes the Brahmic compression gap at the 131K-vocabulary class while preserving the English, EU-language, and code compression of OpenAI's o200k_base. We construct it through a two-stage retrofit: (1) a script-prune crop that reduces 200,019 tokens to 131,072 by removing nine out-of-scope writing systems, and (2) a surgical retrofit of 2,372 corpus-dead vocabulary slots determined by linear-programming allocati

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、但对多语种预训练代价影响很大的问题：在固定词表预算下，主流 byte-level BPE tokenizer 对婆罗米系文字覆盖严重不足，导致印地语、孟加拉语、奥里亚语等语言大量退化到 byte fallback，token 数暴涨，训练和推理成本被系统性抬高。作者不是重新训练一个全新 tokenizer，而是试图在不破坏 o200k_base 英文、欧洲语言和代码压缩能力的前提下，把它改造成一个 131K 词表、可直接替换的 Indic-capable tokenizer。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，这是 tokenizer 设计里的一个很实用的 recipe：在既有强 tokenizer 上做受约束 retrofit，而不是从头训练，目标是保住已有生态兼容性、merge 规则和下游训练管线。第二，它把“多语种不公平”从泛泛的能力讨论，落到了可验证的结构问题：某些 Unicode block 在词表里几乎没有 token，于是字符级信息被迫走 byte fallback，token fertility 和训练 compute 直接失衡。第三，它说明词表大小不是唯一决定因素，词表内容分配和 dead slots 利用方式同样关键。对做 multilingual pretrain、continual pretrain、tokenizer migration 的人，这篇文章提供了一个低风险改造路径。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两步。第一步是 script-prune crop：从 o200k_base 的 200,019 个 token 中裁剪到 131,072，删除九类非目标书写系统覆盖的 38,345 个 token，保留英文、法德西语、代码、数学以及九个 Brahmic Unicode blocks 相关能力。第二步是 surgical retrofit：在裁剪后的词表中，找出 2,372 个 corpus-dead vocabulary slots，也就是在目标语料上几乎不被使用、但占着词表位置的 token，然后通过线性规划把这些空位分配给九个 Brahmic Unicode block 的高频内容。关键点不在于重新学习 merge，而在于保持 pre-tokenizer、decoder 和继承自 o200k_base 的 merge rules 不变，只替换词表中的具体条目，因此它在 tokenizer interface 上是 drop-in replacement。

这个设计有几个值得注意的取舍。作者没有动 merge 规则，意味着英文和代码的分词边界大体继承自 o200k_base，兼容性高，但也限制了对 Indic 语言做更激进重构的空间。作者选择“补高频 token + 利用 dead slots”，而不是全面重训 BPE，核心原因是要尽量保住已有强项，并把风险控制在局部。线性规划分配则体现出一个工程判断：不同 Brahmic block 的收益不一样，不能平均分配词表名额，而应按语料频率和压缩收益做预算分配。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面比较完整，比较对象有 13 个公开 tokenizer，跨 48K 到 262K 四个词表规模、四类 pre-tokenizer。核心结果有几组。

1. 在 2700 万文档、28.4 亿词、46.21GB 的 Indic 预训练语料上，BrahmicTokenizer-131K 相比同为 131K 词表的 Tekken/Sarvam-m 总 token 数减少 26.7%。如果训练语料以 Indic 为主，这几乎可以直接理解成每步训练 compute 下降约 27%。

2. 优势覆盖 11/11 个 Brahmic 语言，幅度从 Tamil 的 15.79% 到 Odia 的 76.79%。Odia 是最能说明结构问题的例子：作者给出单句示例，37 个字符被 BrahmicTokenizer 切成 21 token，而 Tekken/Sarvam-m 切成 99 token；在 6030 万词的 Odia 子语料上，这种差距仍有 4.31 倍。原因也被直接验证：Tekken/Sarvam-m 的 131K 词表里没有 Oriya Unicode block token，于是每个字符基本都退化成 3 个 byte token。

3. 英文压缩几乎保持不变。FLORES-200 English 上是 1.235 tokens/word，o200k_base 是 1.232，Tekken/Sarvam-m 是 1.267。对 1000 篇英文文档，和 o200k_cropped 在 96.8% 文档上 tokenization 完全一致，总 token 数差异只有 0.034%。这说明 retrofit 的扰动确实很小。

4. 代码和数学压缩表现很好。HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K 上分别达到 0.295、0.320、0.301 tokens/character。相对 Tekken/Sarvam-m 分别好 4.0%、5.4%、14.2%；相对词表规模是其两倍的 Sarvam-30B tokenizer，也仍然领先 13.2%、21.3%、16.6%。作者特别指出 GSM8K 的优势与 o200k_base 保留下来的单数字 tokenization 有关，这个细节对 reasoning/coding 预训练很重要。

5. 欧洲语言压缩基本维持竞争力。摘要截断处没有给完全部数字，但文中给出法语 1.464、德语 1.653、西语 1.388 tokens/word，说明裁剪和 retrofit 没有明显伤到这些高资源语言。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓三部分。

第一，看 Introduction 里关于 Odia 和 FLORES fertility 的例子。这里把问题讲得很直观，也说明作者为什么把“结构性缺 token”当成主要矛盾，而不是泛泛讨论 tokenizer 训练语料偏差。

第二，看方法部分里 script-prune crop 和 surgical retrofit 的具体定义，尤其是 corpus-dead slots 的判定方式、线性规划如何在不同 Unicode block 间分配名额。这部分决定了它是不是一个可复用 recipe，而不只是一次性手工修补。

第三，看实验中的 structural diagnostics 和 code/math compression。前者回答“为什么会好”，后者回答“改了 Indic 之后有没有伤到英文和代码”。如果时间有限，先看总表、Odia 个案、英文一致性统计、HumanEval/MBPP/GSM8K 三组结果，20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。

值得深挖的点有两个：一是 dead slots 的定义是否依赖特定语料分布，换到更广的 multilingual web corpus 会不会失效；二是保持 merge rules 不变的前提下，retrofit 的上限在哪里，是否还能继续扩展到阿拉伯文、东南亚文字等其他被低估脚本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete tokenizer design problem with direct pretraining implications: mainstream byte-level BPE tokenizers under fixed vocabulary budgets allocate too little capacity to Brahmic scripts, so many Indic languages fall back to byte-level segmentation and suffer massive token inflation. The goal is not to train a new tokenizer from scratch, but to turn o200k_base into a 131K-vocabulary drop-in replacement that substantially improves Indic compression while preserving English, European-language, and code behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining work is practical rather than cosmetic. First, it presents a constrained tokenizer-retrofitting recipe: modify a strong existing tokenizer while keeping the tokenizer interface, pre-tokenizer, decoder, and merge rules stable. That matters for migration cost and training-pipeline compatibility. Second, it makes multilingual inequity measurable at the vocabulary-structure level: if a script has near-zero representation in the vocabulary, token fertility and training compute become systematically skewed. Third, it shows that vocabulary size alone is a weak proxy; allocation quality and the reuse of dead vocabulary slots matter a lot. For multilingual pretraining, tokenizer refreshes, and continual-pretrain settings, this is a useful engineering pattern.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two stages. Stage one is a script-prune crop: starting from the 200,019-token o200k_base vocabulary, the authors reduce it to 131,072 tokens by removing 38,345 tokens associated with nine out-of-scope writing systems, while keeping the useful English/EU/code/math behavior inherited from o200k_base. Stage two is a surgical retrofit: within the cropped vocabulary, they identify 2,372 corpus-dead slots, meaning vocabulary entries that are effectively unused on the target corpus, and reassign those slots to high-frequency Brahmic content using a linear-programming allocation across nine Brahmic Unicode blocks.

The key design choice is what they do not change. The pre-tokenizer, decoder, and inherited merge rules remain untouched. This makes the tokenizer a drop-in replacement at the interface level and preserves much of the original segmentation behavior for English and code. The trade-off is clear: by not relearning merges, they give up some freedom to globally optimize Indic segmentation, but they gain compatibility and sharply reduce the risk of hurting strong existing domains. The LP-based slot allocation is also important: vocabulary budget is treated as a scarce resource that should be distributed according to corpus utility, not evenly across scripts.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is fairly broad: 13 public tokenizers, four vocabulary classes from 48K to 262K, and four pre-tokenizer types. The main results are as follows.

1. On a 27M-document Indic pretraining corpus with 2.84B words and 46.21GB of text, BrahmicTokenizer-131K produces 26.7% fewer tokens than Tekken/Sarvam-m, which has the same 131K vocabulary budget. For Indic-heavy pretraining, that is close to a 27% reduction in per-step compute.

2. The gain holds for all 11 Brahmic languages, ranging from 15.79% on Tamil to 76.79% on Odia. Odia is the clearest structural case: a 37-character sentence becomes 21 tokens with the proposed tokenizer but 99 tokens with Tekken/Sarvam-m, and the same pattern persists at corpus scale with a 4.31x ratio on a 60.3M-word Odia subset. The reason is directly verifiable from the vocabulary: Tekken/Sarvam-m contains zero tokens from the Oriya Unicode block, so characters collapse to byte fallback.

3. English compression is nearly unchanged. On FLORES-200 English, the tokenizer gets 1.235 tokens/word versus 1.232 for o200k_base and 1.267 for Tekken/Sarvam-m. On 1,000 English documents, tokenization is byte-identical to o200k_cropped on 96.8% of documents, and the total token-count difference is only 0.034%.

4. Code and math compression remain strong. The tokenizer achieves 0.295, 0.320, and 0.301 tokens/character on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K. Compared with Tekken/Sarvam-m, it is better by 4.0%, 5.4%, and 14.2%. It also beats the much larger-vocabulary Sarvam-30B tokenizer by 13.2%, 21.3%, and 16.6% on the same three sets. The GSM8K gain is tied to preserving o200k_base’s digit tokenization behavior, which is relevant for reasoning and code pretraining.

5. European-language compression stays competitive, with reported FLORES values of 1.464 for French, 1.653 for German, and 1.388 for Spanish.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts.

First, read the introduction examples around Odia and FLORES fertility. They make the failure mode concrete and show why the paper frames the issue as a vocabulary-coverage problem rather than a vague multilingual-quality problem.

Second, read the method details for script-prune crop and surgical retrofit, especially how corpus-dead slots are defined and how the linear program allocates slots across Unicode blocks. That is the reusable part of the work.

Third, inspect the structural diagnostics and the code/math compression tables. Those sections answer the two practical questions that matter most: why the tokenizer improves Indic compression, and whether the retrofit damages English or code. If time is limited, the main corpus-level table, the Odia case study, the English identity statistics, and the HumanEval/MBPP/GSM8K results are enough to capture the paper in about 20–30 minutes.

Two follow-up questions are worth thinking about: how corpus-dependent the notion of dead slots is, and how far this retrofit strategy can scale if one wants to cover other underrepresented scripts without changing merge rules.

recommendation.zh: 这不是花哨算法，而是很干净的 tokenizer surgery：如果你做多语种预训练，应该立刻检查自己词表里有多少 dead slots，方法可直接 internal 复现。
recommendation.en: Not flashy, but this is clean tokenizer surgery: if you run multilingual pretraining, you should immediately audit dead vocab slots and replicate the retrofit internally.

paper.title: Kronecker Embeddings: Byte-Level Structured Token Representations for Parameter-Efficient Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models route every input through a learned embedding table of shape |V| x d_model, consuming hundreds of millions to billions of trainable parameters at frontier scale. We introduce Kronecker Embeddings, a deterministic byte-level character-position factorization that replaces this table with a fixed encoder and a single learned projection, compatible with standard BPE tokenizers, eliminating 91--94% of input-side trainable parameters at frontier scale. We provide five contributio

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图减少大语言模型输入 embedding table 的参数和训练开销，同时保持与现有 BPE tokenizer 的兼容性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 tokenizer 与 embedding 参数化。现代模型的输入 embedding 在大词表和大 hidden size 下会变成显著参数项，例如 130K vocab、4096 hidden size 约 5.37 亿参数；250K vocab、24576 hidden size 可到约 61.4 亿参数。Adam 类优化器还会放大显存和 checkpoint 成本。作者提出的观点是，embedding table 未必需要为每个 token 学一个独立向量；许多 trained embeddings 近邻主要反映大小写、前导空格、前导标点等排版变体，而不是严格形态学关系。这个观察支持用 token 字符串结构来替代大表查找，尤其适合大词表、多语种和 tokenizer 扩展场景。
summary.technical_approach: Kronecker Embeddings 用确定性的 byte-level character-position factorization 替代 learned token embedding table。每个 BPE token 仍然保留原 tokenizer 输出，但不再直接查 |V| × d_model 的可训练矩阵，而是把 token 字符串拆成 bytes，并结合 byte identity 与 position basis 构造 Kronecker product 表示。这个固定编码器把 token 映射到结构化特征，再通过一个 learned projection 投到模型 hidden size。这样参数量主要来自投影矩阵，而不是词表大小乘以 hidden size 的大表。方法的取舍很明确：它牺牲每个 token 独立学习任意向量的自由度，换来更强的字符串结构先验、更小的输入侧可训练参数，以及更少的 optimizer state 和 checkpoint 压力。它不是重新设计 tokenizer，而是在现有 BPE token 上重新参数化 embedding。
summary.experiments: 实验分两类。第一类是跨模型 embedding probe，覆盖 Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen3-32B、Gemma-3-1B-pt、DeepSeek-V3-Base、GPT-OSS-120B、SmolLM2-135M，参数规模从 135M 到 671B，tokenizer family 也不同。作者观察到，训练好的 input embeddings 对 probe word 的最近邻常常是排版变体，例如 run 的近邻包括带空格、大小写变化或前导标点的 run，而 running、runner、ran 等形态相关词并不稳定进入 top-K。DeepSeek-V3-Base 即使训练约 14.8T tokens，也呈现类似模式。第二类是方法验证。Kronecker embedding 在 embedding layer 的近邻更偏 byte-similar strings，例如 run 的近邻可能包括 runs、rund、runner、ru、ron；这说明它摆脱了 trained BPE embedding 中常见的 typographic clustering，但并不等于可靠捕捉严格形态学关系。作者还提到一个 124M controlled training comparison：无论 BPE learned embedding 还是 Kronecker embedding，前两层 transformer 都没有稳定建立严格形态学聚类，BPE 分支中的形态结构还会随层数下降。参数效率方面，摘要声称在 frontier scale 可消除 91–94% input-side trainable parameters。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看引言中对 embedding table 参数、optimizer state、并行通信和 checkpoint 成本的量化，这部分最直接服务于预训练系统设计。再看 Section 6 的 cross-model probe，判断 trained embeddings 到底学到了什么结构。方法部分重点看 Kronecker product 的具体构造：byte basis、position basis、token 长度处理、learned projection 的形状，以及是否影响 tied embedding 或输出 head。实验部分不要只看参数节省，要看 controlled training comparison 中 loss、下游指标和早期层表示分析。值得保留的问题是：这种结构化 embedding 在大规模从头预训练中是否会影响 rare token、多语种脚本、代码 token 和长 token 的学习速度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the large learned input embedding table in LLMs can be replaced by a structured byte-level representation without changing the existing BPE tokenizer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about tokenizer-facing model parameterization. Input embeddings become expensive when both vocabulary size and model width grow. A 130K vocabulary with a 4096-dimensional model already needs about 537M input-embedding parameters; a 250K multilingual vocabulary with width 24576 would need about 6.14B. With Adam-style training, optimizer states further multiply the memory and checkpoint cost. The paper also challenges a common assumption: trained token embeddings do not consistently organize strict morphology at the embedding layer. They often cluster typographic variants such as casing, whitespace, and punctuation. This makes a structured string-based embedding a plausible alternative to a fully learned table.
summary_en.technical_approach: Kronecker Embeddings replace the |V| by d_model input table with a deterministic byte-position encoder plus one learned projection. A BPE token is still produced by the standard tokenizer, but its surface string is encoded through byte identities and positions. These factors are combined through a Kronecker-product representation, producing a fixed structured feature vector for each token. A learned projection maps that feature into the model hidden dimension. The method reduces trainable input-side parameters because the parameter count is no longer directly vocabulary size times model width. The main tradeoff is reduced freedom: each token no longer owns an arbitrary learned vector. In exchange, the model gets a byte-level structural prior and lower optimizer, communication, and checkpoint overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The evidence has two parts. First, the authors probe input embeddings from six public LMs: Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen3-32B, Gemma-3-1B-pt, DeepSeek-V3-Base, GPT-OSS-120B, and SmolLM2-135M, spanning 135M to 671B parameters and several tokenizer families. Nearest neighbors of a probe word such as run are dominated by typographic variants, including case changes, leading whitespace, and leading punctuation. Morphological relatives such as running, runner, and ran are not reliably retrieved. The same pattern appears even for DeepSeek-V3-Base, which is described as trained on 14.8T tokens. Second, the proposed Kronecker representation yields byte-similar neighbors at the embedding layer, for example runs, rund, runner, ru, and ron for run. This avoids the typographic clustering pattern, but it still does not solve strict morphological clustering: both learned BPE embeddings and Kronecker embeddings retrieve fewer than 30% true morphological family members in top-10 under a stricter criterion. A controlled 124M training comparison further suggests that the first two transformer layers do not robustly build strict morphology on top of either embedding type. The abstract reports a 91–94% reduction in input-side trainable parameters at frontier scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the cost analysis for embedding tables, optimizer states, sharding, and checkpointing. Then read the embedding-neighborhood probe, because it motivates why a learned table may be less semantically structured than often assumed. In the method section, check the exact Kronecker construction: byte basis, position basis, handling of token length, projection size, and compatibility with tied input-output embeddings. In the training comparison, focus on loss curves, downstream metrics, and early-layer representation probes. The open question worth tracking is whether this parameterization remains neutral during large-scale pretraining on multilingual text, code, rare tokens, and long byte sequences.

recommendation.zh: 嵌入层参数占比随词表扩大快速攀升，该方法能省90%+参数还提效，建议立刻在内部小模型 ablation 中验证可行性。
recommendation.en: Embedding layer cost grows rapidly with vocabulary size; this method cuts 90%+ parameters while improving performance, worth immediate ablation on internal small models.
