summary.core_problem: 脑机接口领域现有方法多为单任务专用模型，缺乏能统一多任务并利用任务间协同的通用框架
summary.importance: 首次提出统一七类脑-视-语编码解码任务的多任务框架，核心创新是脑信号Tokenizer和离散扩散建模
summary.technical_approach: Mind-Omni框架：(1) Brain Tokenizer将异构连续脑信号转换为标准离散token；(2) 通过离散扩散在共享语义空间实现多模态token级交互；(3) 构建Brain QA指令微调数据集解锁推理能力
summary.experiments: 在七类任务上取得多任务统一框架中的SOTA；提供了详细的跨任务迁移和协同分析

summary_en.core_problem: BCI research is dominated by specialized single-task models, lacking a versatile framework that unifies multiple tasks and exploits inter-task synergies
summary_en.importance: First versatile framework unifying seven brain-vision-language encoding/decoding tasks via discrete diffusion; core innovation is the Brain Tokenizer for neural signal discretization
summary_en.technical_approach: Mind-Omni framework: (1) Brain Tokenizer converts heterogeneous continuous brain signals to standardized discrete tokens; (2) discrete diffusion enables token-level cross-modal interactions in shared semantic space; (3) Brain QA instruction-tuning dataset unlocks reasoning capabilities
summary_en.experiments: Establishes SOTA among multi-task unified frameworks across seven tasks; provides detailed cross-task transfer and synergy analysis

recommendation.zh: BCI领域的多模态tokenization和离散扩散应用有一定参考价值，但属于非常细分的领域，不建议预训练研究员投入时间
recommendation.en: The Brain Tokenizer and discrete diffusion application in BCI have some architectural novelty but are in a very specialized domain. Not worth a pretraining researcher's time.

paper.title: X-Token: Projection-Guided Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: Cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation allows a student model to learn from teachers with incompatible vocabularies. Prior work operates on hidden states or logits; the latter is preferred as a drop-in replacement requiring no auxiliary components. Logit-based methods either use only the correct-token probability, missing the full 'dark knowledge' in the teacher's distribution, or operate on the full output distribution, relying on strict token partitioning and/or unprincipled heuristic ranking.

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是跨 tokenizer 知识蒸馏中的“词表不兼容”问题。标准 KD 在每个位置对 teacher 与 student 的 next-token 分布做 KL，需要共享 tokenizer；这会把 student 绑定到同一 tokenizer 家族，限制了使用 Qwen、Phi、Llama 等异构 teacher 的能力。已有 logit-based 方法虽然部署成本低，但要么只用正确 token 概率，丢掉 teacher 分布里的暗知识；要么把词表切成 common/uncommon 两部分，依赖严格字符串匹配和 rank-based 对齐，导致两类问题：关键 token 落入 unmatched subset 后被错误压低，例如多位数字；以及等价 token 或 teacher 多 token 分解无法被利用，例如 student 的一个词对应 teacher 的多个子词。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把跨 tokenizer KD 从启发式 rank matching 推向了可审计、可扩展的词表投影。对基座预训练和持续预训练有直接意义：第一，student 可以保持自己的 tokenizer，不必为了吃到更强 teacher 的信号而换词表；第二，可以做跨家族 multi-teacher KD，把不同 teacher 的推理、代码、多语能力合成到同一个训练信号里；第三，方法仍然是 logit-level loss，避免 representation alignment 那类额外模块和额外 forward 的成本，更接近大规模 continual pretraining 可用的形态。贡献量级主要体现在失败模式修复，而不是单纯小幅调参：在 Qwen3-4B teacher 场景，P-KL 对 GOLD 平均提升 +3.82，GSM8K 从 2.56 提到 15.54，说明 numerals 这类 critical token 的处理不是边角问题。
summary.technical_approach: X-Token 有三步。第一步是 span alignment。不同 tokenizer 会把同一段文本切成不同长度的 token 序列，因此不能直接逐位置做 KD。论文用确定性的动态规划对齐，把 student token span 与 teacher token span 分组成解码后文本一致的 chunk。随后用 chain-rule merge，把一个 chunk 内的自回归 token 概率相乘，得到 chunk-level distribution。这样 KD 的单位从单 token 位置变成文本一致的 span。第二步是构造稀疏 projection matrix W，尺寸为 |V_S| × |V_T|，把 student 词表上的概率映射到 teacher 词表空间。W 不是简单 string equality，而是使用 canonicalized string matching 和 multi-token decoding rules，把大小写、空格、规范化形式以及 teacher 多 token 分解带来的等价关系纳入匹配。这个矩阵可以固定，也可以在 KD 中进一步 refine。第三步是两个互补 loss。P-KL 去掉 common/uncommon partition，在投影后的完整分布上做 KL，适合关键 token 大量落在严格 common set 之外的情形，例如跨 tokenizer 数字切分差异。H-KL 则保留一种更保守的高置信映射，用 W 下的 top-ranked mapping 放宽匹配，适合覆盖率已经较好、但严格字符串匹配仍漏掉等价项的情形。论文给出一个实用的 coverage audit：先检查 numerals 等任务关键 token 在 common set 与 projection 下的覆盖情况，再决定用 P-KL 还是 H-KL。multi-teacher 扩展把多个异构 teacher 的 projected loss 加权合并；实验中简单静态权重优于自适应权重，提示 teacher 互补性和稳定权重比复杂调度更重要。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 Llama-3.2-1B 这类固定 tokenizer 的 student，蒸馏来自 Phi-4-mini、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 等 teacher 的信号。核心结果有三组。第一，Qwen3-4B teacher 下，P-KL 相对 GOLD 平均提升 +3.82；GSM8K 从 2.56 提升到 15.54，接近 6 倍。这与论文诊断一致：Qwen 对多位数字的切分和 Llama 的 packed numeral 不一致，GOLD 的 common/uncommon 切分会把关键数字 token 放到弱监督甚至错误监督区域。第二，Phi-4-mini teacher 下，H-KL 带来稳定的约 +0.5 平均提升，说明当 critical token 覆盖没有严重破损时，更保守的高质量映射比 full-distribution 投影更稳。第三，multi-teacher KD 中，Phi-4-mini + Llama-3.2-3B 比单 teacher KD 高 +1.3；teacher 组合是否互补比 teacher 数量更重要。消融层面，值得关注的是 projection 覆盖率、W 是否 refine、P-KL 与 H-KL 的选择，以及 static weighting 与 adaptive weighting 的比较。论文的数字还显示，跨 tokenizer KD 的主要风险不是 KL 形式本身，而是错误匹配产生的系统性梯度偏置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 GOLD/ULD 失败模式的拆解，尤其是 uncommon-token failure 和 over-conservative matching。这两点直接决定方法设计。Method 部分重点看 span alignment、chain-rule merge、projection matrix W 的构造规则，以及 P-KL/H-KL 的公式。这里要关注一个细节：它不是把 token 对齐问题简化成字符串相等，而是先把文本 span 对齐，再把词表概率投影到同一空间。实验部分建议优先看三类表和图：不同 teacher 下 P-KL/H-KL/GOLD 的对比；numeral 或其他 critical token 的 coverage audit；multi-teacher 权重策略的消融。深挖点包括：W refine 是否会引入不稳定或过拟合；P-KL 在大词表 teacher 上的计算成本；coverage audit 能否扩展到代码 token、Unicode、多语形态变化；chunk-level distribution 的 chain-rule merge 在长 span 上是否会出现数值和校准问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation when teacher and student models use incompatible vocabularies. Standard logit KD assumes a shared next-token support, which effectively locks a student into teachers from the same tokenizer family. Existing logit-based cross-tokenizer methods either retain only the probability of the gold token or split the vocabulary into string-matched common tokens and an unmatched remainder. This creates two concrete failure modes: important tokens can fall into the unmatched set and receive noisy or suppressive gradients, as in multi-digit numerals under Qwen-to-Llama distillation; and useful equivalences are missed when one tokenizer represents a string as one token while another represents it as multiple tokens.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to continual pretraining and model upgrading. It lets a fixed-tokenizer student consume distributional supervision from stronger or specialized teachers without changing the student tokenizer or adding representation-alignment modules. This matters for multi-teacher distillation across model families, where teachers may differ in reasoning, code, and multilingual strengths. The main contribution is not a small loss tweak, but a more principled interface between mismatched vocabularies. The reported gains are also tied to a real pretraining concern: tokenization artifacts can create systematic training bias. With Qwen3-4B as teacher, P-KL improves over GOLD by +3.82 on average, including GSM8K moving from 2.56 to 15.54.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Token has three components. First, it aligns student and teacher token sequences into text-consistent spans. Because different tokenizers produce different sequence lengths, per-position KD is ill-defined. The method uses deterministic dynamic-programming alignment to form paired chunks that decode to the same underlying text. Within each chunk, token probabilities are merged using the autoregressive chain rule to obtain chunk-level distributions. Second, it builds a sparse projection matrix W of shape |V_S| by |V_T|, mapping student-vocabulary probabilities into the teacher vocabulary space. The projection is constructed with canonicalized string matching and multi-token decoding rules, rather than exact string equality alone, and it can optionally be refined during KD. Third, it introduces two loss variants. P-KL removes the common/uncommon partition and aligns full projected distributions, which is useful when critical tokens are poorly covered by strict common-token matching. H-KL uses top-ranked mappings under W and is better suited to cases where the common coverage is already reasonably good but exact matching is too conservative. A coverage audit over categories such as numerals guides the choice between P-KL and H-KL. The multi-teacher extension combines projected KD losses from heterogeneous teachers, with static weighting reported to be more reliable than adaptive weighting.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments study fixed-tokenizer students such as Llama-3.2-1B distilled from teachers including Phi-4-mini, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B. Three results are central. Under Qwen3-4B supervision, P-KL outperforms GOLD by +3.82 on average, and GSM8K rises from 2.56 to 15.54. This matches the diagnosed numeral-tokenization failure: Qwen and Llama segment multi-digit numbers differently, and partition-based KD gives poor gradients to the tokens that determine math accuracy. Under Phi-4-mini supervision, H-KL gives a consistent gain of about +0.5, suggesting that a more conservative high-quality mapping is preferable when critical-token coverage is not badly broken. In multi-teacher KD, Phi-4-mini plus Llama-3.2-3B improves by +1.3 over single-teacher KD. The ablations to inspect are projection coverage, fixed versus refined W, P-KL versus H-KL selection, and static versus adaptive teacher weighting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the failure analysis in the introduction carefully. The two useful concepts are uncommon-token failure and over-conservative matching; they explain why previous full-distribution logit KD can harm exactly the tokens that matter for downstream accuracy. In the method, focus on span alignment, chain-rule merging, construction of the projection matrix W, and the definitions of P-KL and H-KL. The key design choice is that X-Token aligns text spans first and then projects distributions, instead of relying on exact token-string equality. In the experiments, prioritize the tables comparing GOLD, P-KL, and H-KL across teachers; the coverage audit for numerals or other critical categories; and the multi-teacher weighting ablation. Open questions worth checking are the compute cost of full projected distributions, numerical stability for long chunks, whether W refinement can drift, and how the same audit would behave for code tokens, Unicode-heavy text, and multilingual morphology.

recommendation.zh: NVIDIA团队提出的跨tokenizer蒸馏方法，指出了Llama→Qwen蒸馏中数字token被压制的具体问题，对模型迁移和tokenizer兼容性研究有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: NVIDIA team's cross-tokenizer distillation method identifies concrete issues with numeric token suppression in Llama→Qwen distillation, directly relevant for model transfer and tokenizer compatibility research.

paper.title: Check Your LLM's Secret Dictionary! Five Lines of Code Reveal What Your LLM Learned (Including What It Shouldn't Have)
paper.abstract: We show that singular value decomposition of the lm_head} weight matrix of a transformer-based large language model -- requiring only five lines of PyTorch and no model inference -- reveals interpretable semantic subspaces directly from the model weights. Each left singular vector identifies the vocabulary tokens most readily selected when the hidden state aligns with the corresponding singular direction; inspecting these clusters exposes the model's training data composition and curation philos

summary.core_problem: 用最小代价从模型权重中读出词表层面的语义结构、数据痕迹和可能不该被学到的内容。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和诊断工具。它把 lm_head 的线性代数结构当作模型训练数据与词表偏好的观测窗口，对 tokenizer、数据混合、数据清洗痕迹有一定参考价值，但证据主要来自少量模型的定性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单：对 transformer LM 的 lm_head 权重矩阵做奇异值分解，不做推理、不采样、不访问训练数据；然后查看奇异向量对应的高权重 token cluster，解释不同奇异方向上的语义、语言、拼写或领域子空间。
summary.experiments: 分析了 GPT-OSS-120B、Gemma-2-2B、Qwen2.5-1.5B。观察到 GPT 的奇异谱和 token cluster 呈现分层功能分化，Gemma 中旧式英语正字法占比较高且形成阶梯状聚类，Qwen 覆盖更广的多语 token 子空间。摘要未给出定量验证、人工标注一致性或下游行为相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a model's vocabulary-level semantic structure and training-data traces can be read directly from the output head weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a lightweight interpretability and diagnostic proposal. It is relevant to data curation, tokenizer effects, and model auditing, but the current evidence appears mostly qualitative and based on a small set of models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method applies SVD to the lm_head matrix of a transformer language model and inspects the tokens with large loadings along each singular direction. No inference, prompting, or training-data access is required.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers GPT-OSS-120B, Gemma-2-2B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B. The reported observations include differentiated functional subspaces in GPT, strong old-English orthographic clusters in Gemma, and broad multilingual subspaces in Qwen. The abstract does not report quantitative validation or causal links to behavior.

recommendation.zh: 把它当 cheap weight audit 的想法看，别把语义 cluster 直接等同训练数据；扫 SVD 图和案例即可。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a cheap weight-audit probe, not as proof of training data composition; skim the SVD plots and token clusters.

paper.title: RQ-MoE: Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts for Efficient Input-Dependent Vector Compression
paper.abstract: Vector quantization is a fundamental tool for compressing high-dimensional embeddings, yet existing multi-codebook methods rely on static codebooks that limit expressiveness under heterogeneous data geometry. While recent dynamic quantizers like QINCo adapt codebooks to individual inputs and improve expressiveness, their strict sequential dependencies create decoding bottlenecks. We propose Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts (RQ-MoE), a framework combining a two-level MoE with dual-str

summary.core_problem: 如何在保持高压缩率/低失真的同时，让向量量化具备输入自适应能力且解码可并行，避免顺序残差量化的瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对embedding/latent压缩、向量tokenizer、以及推理侧向量检索/缓存压缩有潜在借鉴；但不直接触及LLM预训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RQ-MoE：两层MoE + 双流量化，实现“动态构造codebook”的输入依赖量化，并通过将“指令/路由”与“量化”解耦来支持并行解码；理论上把标准Residual Quantization与QINCo视为其受限特例，并给出expert维度设置指导。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多项向量量化实验上达到SOTA或持平，并强调相对QINCo减少顺序依赖带来的解码瓶颈；未在摘要中给出数据集、码率-失真曲线、吞吐/延迟数字与关键消融。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve input-adaptive vector quantization with high fidelity while enabling parallel decoding, avoiding the sequential bottleneck of residual quantizers like QINCo.
summary_en.importance: Potentially useful for embedding/latent compression and vector tokenizers (and some inference-side compression), though it does not directly change LLM pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: RQ-MoE: a two-level MoE with dual-stream quantization to build input-dependent codebooks; decouples instruction/routing from quantization to allow parallel decoding. Shows standard Residual Quantization and QINCo as constrained special cases and derives a guideline for expert dimensionality.
summary_en.experiments: Claims SOTA or on-par performance on vector quantization benchmarks and improved decoding parallelism vs QINCo; the abstract lacks datasets, rate-distortion curves, latency/throughput numbers, and key ablations.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“向量tokenizer/latent压缩”的工程备选：重点看并行解码怎么做、以及RQ/QINCo特例化推导；别指望直接改LLM预训练。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an engineering option for vector tokenizers/latent compression: focus on how parallel decoding is enabled and the RQ/QINCo-as-special-cases derivation; it won’t directly move LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Convergent Evolution: How Different Language Models Learn Similar Number Representations
paper.abstract: Language models trained on natural text learn to represent numbers using periodic features with dominant periods at $T=2, 5, 10$. In this paper, we identify a two-tiered hierarchy of these features: while Transformers, Linear RNNs, LSTMs, and classical word embeddings trained in different ways all learn features that have period-$T$ spikes in the Fourier domain, only some learn geometrically separable features that can be used to linearly classify a number mod-$T$. To explain this incongruity, w

summary.core_problem: 很多工作把“数字 token embedding 出现 T=2/5/10 的傅里叶尖峰”解读为模型学到了可用的数概念结构。但全文给出的核心问题更尖锐：为什么几乎所有系统（Transformer、线性 RNN、LSTM、传统词向量，甚至仅语料频次分布）都会出现相似的频谱尖峰（spectral convergence），但只有一部分系统的数字 embedding 才能把 n mod T 线性可分（geometric convergence）？也就是：频谱尖峰到底来自数据/分词的统计偏置，还是来自模型学到的可计算结构；以及什么条件决定“尖峰”能否转化为可线性解码的模结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要在“机制归因”和“数据-分词-优化-架构耦合”两点。第一，它把一个常见的机制解释（数字 embedding 的周期结构=模型学会了模运算）拆成两层，并证明“有尖峰”并不等价于“可线性读出模类”，避免把数据诱导的统计结构误当成模型能力。第二，它用受控训练把几类因素（数据中的数字共现与跨数字交互、上下文长度、架构、优化器、tokenizer）逐一剥离，给出更工程化的结论：哪些信号会让几何可分出现，哪些只会保留频谱尖峰。这类结论对做数据配比、tokenizer 设计、以及解释训练动态（为什么某些结构在某些架构里“长出来”）都直接有用。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三块。
1) 现象与度量：固定研究对象为 0..999 的数字 token embedding e(n)。沿 token index 做 DFT，观察功率谱在 1/T 处的尖峰（T=2/5/10）。同时用线性 probe（T 类 logistic regression）预测 n mod T，作为“几何可分/可线性读出”的 operational 定义。
2) 理论区分：给出结论“傅里叶域稀疏（有尖峰）是 mod-T 可分的必要条件，但不是充分条件”。直观上，尖峰只说明 embedding 在 token 序上有周期分量；但要线性分开 residue class，需要这些周期分量在几何上形成可被一个线性分类器稳定切分的簇/方向结构。论文用定理（Theorem 1）形式化了这种不充分性，并解释了为何两个系统可以有几乎相同的频谱，却 probe 准确率天差地别。
3) 结构归因式的受控实验：在相同规模（文中强调 300M 参数）与相同训练数据的条件下，系统性改变单一因素来观察“尖峰是否仍在”与“probe 是否掉到随机”。数据侧做逐步去除：削弱文本-数字共现、削弱跨数字交互、缩短上下文等；架构侧对比 Transformer、线性 RNN、LSTM；优化侧比较不同优化器在相同架构下对几何可分的影响；tokenizer 侧用“从零训练加法”任务对比单 token vs 多 token 表示数字，展示多 token 加法会强迫出现模子问题（例如按位/按块的模 1000 结构），从而更稳定地产生圆形/周期表示，而单 token 加法存在多种可行策略，表示会更依赖优化路径（optimizer-dependent）。
summary.experiments:
全文实验的关键不是单一 SOTA 数字，而是“同频谱、不同可分性”的对照与消融趋势。
- 广泛性：在多种已发布模型与非 Transformer 系统、以及 GloVe/FastText 中都观察到 T=2/5/10 的尖峰；甚至仅统计训练语料中数字 token 的频次分布也出现相似频谱（用来支持“数据/分词诱导”的解释）。
- 两层收敛：spectral convergence 几乎处处存在；geometric convergence 只在部分系统出现。文中给出强对照：Transformer 与线性 RNN（在约 10B token 训练设置下）能把 mod-T 线性 probe 做到很高，而 LSTM 在相同数据下即使尖峰更显著，probe 仍接近随机水平。
- 数据消融：逐步移除文本-数字共现、跨数字交互、或缩短上下文长度，会显著降低 mod-T probe；但傅里叶尖峰在这些条件下仍然顽固存在，支持“尖峰更像数据统计投影，几何可分需要额外语义/组合信号”的判断。
- 架构/优化：架构对几何可分是决定性的（Transformer/线性 RNN vs LSTM）；优化器在某些设置下会改变是否学到可分结构，但不会改变尖峰出现这一事实。
- tokenizer 与任务约束：在从零训练的加法任务里，多 token 表示数字会迫使模型解决按位/按块的模子问题，从而更稳定地产生周期/圆形结构；单 token 表示数字时，模型可能走不同捷径，导致表示对优化路径更敏感、结果更不稳定。
（注：你给的全文片段未包含所有表格具体数值；上述以论文主线结论与对照关系为主，数字细节应以正文图表为准。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“先建立区分，再看归因”走。
- 先看问题设定与度量：Problem Setup 里 DFT 的定义、Fourier spike 的 operational 定义、以及 mod-T 线性 probe 的设置。这里决定了后面所有结论的可比性。
- 重点看理论段落（含 Theorem 1）：抓住“必要不充分”的条件到底卡在哪里。建议对照论文给出的反例/解释：同样的频谱稀疏如何对应到不同的几何布局。
- 重点看三组受控实验：
  1) 数据信号逐步移除的消融（最能说明‘尖峰不等于能力’）；
  2) 架构对照（Transformer/线性 RNN/LSTM 在同数据同规模下的 probe 差异）；
  3) tokenizer + 加法任务（多 token 强约束如何“逼出”模结构）。
- 如果时间有限：只看 Figure 1/2（广泛性与语料频谱）、以及架构对照与数据消融对应的主图，就能把论文的核心论证链条串起来。

summary_en.core_problem: Prior work often treats Fourier spikes (dominant periods around T=2/5/10) in number token embeddings as evidence that LMs learn structured numerical representations. The paper’s actual core question is sharper: why do Fourier spikes ("spectral convergence") appear almost universally—across Transformers, linear RNNs, LSTMs, classical word embeddings, and even the raw corpus frequency of number tokens—while only some systems yield embeddings where residue classes n mod T are linearly decodable ("geometric convergence")? In other words, what part is a data/tokenization-induced statistical artifact, and what part reflects a learned, functionally usable modular structure—and which training conditions control the transition from spectral to geometric convergence?
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly methodological and interpretability-relevant for pretraining research. (1) It cleanly separates two phenomena that are frequently conflated: periodic spectra vs linearly usable modular codes. This prevents over-interpreting a ubiquitous spectral signature as a learned arithmetic capability. (2) It runs controlled “structure attribution” experiments that isolate how data signals (text–number co-occurrence, cross-number interactions, context length), architecture choice, optimizer, and tokenizer jointly determine whether modular structure becomes linearly accessible. These findings are directly actionable for data design, tokenizer decisions, and for understanding training dynamics where certain representations reliably emerge in some architectures but not others.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach has three pillars.
1) Metrics and setup: focus on embeddings e(n) for number tokens n in 0..999 (aligned with common tokenizers where these are single tokens). Compute a DFT along the token index and measure power at frequencies 1/T to identify spikes. Separately, train a linear probe (T-way logistic regression) to predict n mod T from e(n), operationalizing “geometric separability.”
2) Theory: prove that Fourier-domain sparsity/spikes are necessary but not sufficient for mod-T linear separability (Theorem 1). Intuitively, a periodic component in the sequence of embeddings does not guarantee that residue classes form linearly separable clusters; two systems can share near-identical spectra yet differ drastically in the geometry relevant to linear decoding.
3) Controlled attribution experiments: train ~300M-parameter models on matched data while perturbing one factor at a time. Data-side perturbations progressively remove (i) text–number co-occurrence, (ii) cross-number interaction signals, and (iii) long-context dependencies. Architecture comparisons include Transformers vs linear RNNs vs LSTMs under identical data. Optimizer comparisons test whether optimization path affects geometric convergence even when spectral convergence is stable. Tokenizer effects are probed via training-from-scratch addition tasks: multi-token numbers force modular subproblems (e.g., digit/block-wise modulo constraints), making circular/periodic representations more stable; single-token numbers admit multiple solution strategies, making learned representations more optimizer-dependent.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is built around contrasts and ablations rather than a single headline benchmark.
- Universality: T=2/5/10 spikes are observed across many released LMs and non-Transformer sequence models, plus GloVe/FastText; strikingly, the corpus-level frequency distribution of number tokens already exhibits a similar periodic spectrum.
- Two-tier outcome: spectral convergence is near-universal; geometric convergence is not. A key controlled contrast: Transformers and linear RNNs (in large-token training settings) yield high mod-T probe accuracy, while LSTMs trained on the same data can show even stronger spikes yet remain near chance on mod-T probing.
- Data ablations: removing co-occurrence, cross-number interactions, or reducing context length degrades mod-T probe accuracy substantially, while Fourier spikes persist—supporting the claim that spikes are largely data/tokenization-driven, whereas linear decodability requires additional structured signals.
- Architecture/optimizer: architecture is decisive for geometric convergence; optimizer can affect whether separable structure emerges in some settings, but does not eliminate the spectral spikes.
- Tokenizer/task constraint: in addition-from-scratch, multi-token number representations more reliably induce modular/circular features due to forced modulo subproblems; single-token setups allow alternative shortcuts, leading to higher variance and optimizer dependence.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include all numeric tables; exact probe accuracies and training details should be taken from the corresponding figures/tables in the paper.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order that mirrors the argument.
- Start with the formal setup: how the DFT is computed over e(n), what counts as a Fourier spike, and how the mod-T linear probe is defined.
- Then read the theorem section carefully (Theorem 1): the paper’s main conceptual move is the “necessary but not sufficient” separation; understanding the geometric failure modes is the point.
- Spend most time on the controlled experiments:
  (i) data-signal removal ablations (best evidence that spikes ≠ usable structure),
  (ii) architecture-matched comparisons (Transformer/linear RNN vs LSTM),
  (iii) tokenizer + addition task (why multi-token constraints reliably produce modular codes).
- If time is tight: focus on the early figures showing universality (including corpus frequency spectrum) and the architecture/ablation figures that juxtapose stable spikes with collapsing probe accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你看 probing 结果的方式：看到周期峰值别急着说模型学会了数论结构，先区分 Fourier 稀疏和几何可分；建议直接复现它的 tokenizer/optimizer ablation。
recommendation.en: This should change how you read probing results: a Fourier spike does not mean the model learned modular structure; separate spectral sparsity from geometric separability and replicate the tokenizer/optimizer ablations.

paper.title: Optimizing Korean-Centric LLMs via Token Pruning
paper.abstract: This paper presents a systematic benchmark of state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) adapted via token pruning - a compression technique that eliminates tokens and embedding parameters corresponding to languages irrelevant to the target application. Focusing on Korean-centric natural language processing (NLP) tasks, we evaluate architectures including Qwen3, Gemma-3, Llama-3, and Aya across three vocabulary configurations: Original, English-Korean (EnKo), and English-Korean-C

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究：对多语 LLM 做面向目标语言的 token pruning，删掉无关语言词表与嵌入后，是否能在韩语中心场景里减少语言混淆并提升效率与稳定性。
summary.importance: 它不是新的预训练范式，更像一篇面向 tokenizer/词表裁剪的系统性评测。对基座研究员的价值在于：它触及一个常被忽略的问题——多语词表是否在单语部署时引入不必要干扰，以及词表压缩是否会改变跨语迁移与生成稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 作者选取 Qwen3、Gemma-3、Llama-3、Aya 等多语模型，构造三种词表配置：原始词表、英韩词表（EnKo）、英韩中词表（EnKoZh）。核心做法是 token pruning：删除与目标应用无关语言对应的 token 和 embedding 参数，然后在韩语相关任务上比较不同配置的表现，重点观察通用能力、文化知识、指令跟随和机器翻译上的变化。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验覆盖多种主流多语模型和多类韩语中心 benchmark。主要结论是：token pruning 能明显改善生成稳定性，减少语言混杂；在机器翻译等韩语特定任务上常有提升；但指令跟随能力存在明显架构依赖，说明被裁掉的跨语表示并非总是冗余。摘要未给出统一提升幅度、参数规模和具体 baseline 数字，因此结论更适合作为经验信号，而不是可直接采纳的定律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether target-language-oriented token pruning on multilingual LLMs—removing vocabulary entries and embeddings for irrelevant languages—can reduce language interference and improve Korean-centric performance and stability.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining paradigm; it is a systematic study around tokenizer/vocabulary pruning. Its value for foundation-model researchers is that it probes an under-discussed question: whether multilingual vocabularies introduce avoidable interference in single-language deployment, and how vocabulary compression trades off against cross-lingual transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate Qwen3, Gemma-3, Llama-3, and Aya under three vocabulary settings: original, English-Korean (EnKo), and English-Korean-Chinese (EnKoZh). The main intervention is token pruning: removing tokens and embedding parameters associated with languages deemed irrelevant, then comparing performance on Korean-centric tasks spanning general aptitude, cultural literacy, instruction following, and machine translation.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the abstract, experiments cover several mainstream multilingual models and multiple Korean-focused benchmarks. The main findings are that token pruning improves generation stability by reducing language confusion, and often helps Korean-specific tasks such as machine translation. Instruction-following results vary by architecture, suggesting that pruned cross-lingual representations are not always redundant. The abstract does not provide clean effect sizes, model scales, or full baselines, so the paper is more useful as an empirical signal than as a settled rule.

recommendation.zh: 可当 tokenizer/词表裁剪的弱信号看：如果你在做单语部署，先看词表消融；但这更像工程经验，没到能改写多语预训练 prior 的程度。
recommendation.en: Treat this as a weak signal on vocabulary pruning for single-language deployment: worth checking the ablations, but it does not yet overturn multilingual pretraining priors.

paper.title: From Where Words Come: Efficient Regularization of Code Tokenizers Through Source Attribution

summary.core_problem: 代码类 BPE tokenizer 在“仓库/语言来源高度不均衡”的训练语料上容易过拟合：把某些大仓库、重复模板、随机/压缩变量名、甚至损坏文本中的高频片段合并成 token，导致大量 token 在真实训练/推理中几乎不出现（under-trained / unused tokens）。这些 token 不仅浪费词表容量与训练预算，还可能带来推理不稳定、幻觉与 token 级攻击面。论文要解决的是：如何在不推翻 BPE 框架的前提下，用“来源归因（source attribution）”对 BPE 的合并目标做正则化，减少来源单一的合并，从而显著降低 under-trained token。
summary.importance: 这是对基座预训练非常直接的贡献：Tokenizer 是数据效率与 scaling 的关键杠杆之一。论文把“token 过拟合”从经验问题提升为可操作的训练目标修改：用 repository/language 覆盖度作为类似 TF-IDF 的反向权重，抑制只在少数来源出现的合并。对大规模代码预训练尤其重要：1）更少的无用 token 意味着更高的有效词表利用率与更稳定的 embedding 训练；2）减少项目特异 token 可提升跨仓库泛化；3）为 tokenizer 设计提供了一个与数据配比/去重/仓库采样强耦合的视角（tokenizer 训练本身也需要“数据科学”）。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Source-Attributed BPE (SA-BPE)：在标准 byte-level BPE 的贪心合并过程中，不仅统计 pair 的全局频次，还跟踪该 pair 出现的“来源覆盖度”，包括：ℛ=出现过该 pair 的仓库数量（repositories），ℒ=出现过该 pair 的编程语言数量（languages）。基于这两个量做两类改造：
1）Merge skipping（合并跳过）：在每一步选择高频 pair 时，若该 pair 的 ℛ 或 ℒ 低于阈值（ℛt、ℒt），则跳过该合并，转而考虑下一个候选。其直觉是：沿着 merge tree 往上合并时，覆盖度不会增加（文中强调 ℛ(t)≤ℛ(t_l) 之类的单调性），因此早期抑制“来源单一”的合并能阻断后续形成更长、更项目特异的 token。
2）修改 BPE 目标/打分（正则化频次）：把“只在少数文档出现”的片段降权，思想上与 TF-IDF 相反（不是奖励稀有，而是惩罚来源过窄的高频）。实现上等价于在 pair 频次上乘/加一个与 ℛ、ℒ 相关的惩罚或重排规则，使得跨仓库/跨语言更通用的片段更容易进入词表。
论文还做了系统的 under-trained token 归因分析：用 magikarp 库对 CodeGemma 7B、Qwen2.5 Coder 3B、StarCoder2 3B 的 under-trained token 做检测（取“最不训练”的 2% token），并人工/规则分类其来源（如变量名片段、标点/大小写碎片、非拉丁字符等），据此论证代码 tokenizer 的 under-training 很大比例来自仓库特异的命名与重复模板。
summary.experiments:
实验分两部分：
(1) 诊断：对三种主流代码模型 tokenizer 的 under-trained token 做统计与分类。文中给出一个关键现象：在 StarCoder2 这类更“紧凑”的 tokenizer 中，under-trained token 很大比例来自变量名及其子片段（文段给出 44%），加上标点与大写拉丁相关 token 后合计约 64.8%，支持“仓库过拟合”假设。
(2) 训练验证：作者训练若干小模型，对比标准 BPE 与 SA-BPE 变体，结论是 SA-BPE 能“显著减少 under-trained tokens”。但在你提供的正文截断中，缺少具体的模型规模、语料规模、词表大小、以及减少比例/下游指标的精确数字与表格编号，因此无法在不臆测的情况下复述具体提升幅度（建议回看论文的主结果表与消融表）。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议1.5-2小时）：
1）先读 Analysis 章节与 Table 1（under-trained token 的类别构成），理解问题到底来自“非拉丁字符”还是“仓库特异变量名/模板”。
2）精读 Methodology 的 Algorithm 1（蓝色标注的改动）：重点看 ℛ/ℒ 的定义、统计粒度（仓库与语言如何判定）、以及 merge skipping 的选择策略与复杂度影响。
3）看不同阈值（ℛt、ℒt）与不同正则化打分的消融：它们对词表形态（token 长度分布、标点/标识符片段比例）与 under-trained token 数量的影响。
4）结合你自己的预训练管线深挖两点：a) tokenizer 训练时的仓库采样/去重策略如何改变 ℛ/ℒ 分布；b) 词表“更通用”是否会牺牲某些语言/框架的压缩率，从而影响训练 token 数与 compute（需要用同等 compute 的对照来评估）。

summary_en.core_problem: Code BPE tokenizers trained on highly imbalanced corpora (a few huge repos, repetitive templates, corrupted/randomized identifiers) tend to overfit: they allocate vocabulary to repo-specific merges that are rarely seen during model training or future inference, creating many under-trained/unused tokens. This wastes vocabulary capacity and training budget and can increase instability, hallucinations, and token-level attack surface. The paper addresses how to regularize BPE using source attribution so merges generalize across repositories/languages.
summary_en.importance: Directly relevant to foundation-model pretraining: tokenizer design is a first-order lever for data efficiency and scaling. The work reframes tokenizer overfitting as an objective/selection problem and introduces repository/language coverage as a principled regularizer. For large-scale code pretraining, it suggests a tight coupling between tokenizer training and data science (repo sampling, dedup, language balance) and provides a practical path to reduce wasted embeddings and improve cross-repo generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Source-Attributed BPE (SA-BPE) augments byte-level BPE by tracking, for each candidate pair, (R) the number of repositories in which the pair appears and (L) the number of programming languages in which it appears. Two main modifications are explored:
1) Merge skipping: during greedy merge selection, skip candidate merges whose R or L falls below thresholds (Rt, Lt). The intuition is that source coverage does not increase up the merge tree, so blocking narrow-source merges early prevents long, highly specific tokens later.
2) Objective/score regularization: adjust the BPE merge scoring so that pairs with narrow source support are de-prioritized (conceptually the opposite of TF-IDF: penalize terms that appear in only a small subset of documents/sources), favoring merges that are frequent and broadly supported across repos/languages.
The paper also performs a structured diagnosis of under-trained tokens in existing code tokenizers (CodeGemma, Qwen2.5 Coder, StarCoder2) using magikarp-based indicators and rule-based/manual categorization to identify dominant sources such as identifier fragments and repo-specific artifacts.
summary_en.experiments: Two layers of evidence: (1) Diagnostic analysis on three popular code model tokenizers, selecting the bottom 2% most under-trained tokens and categorizing them; the excerpt reports that for StarCoder2, identifier-related tokens account for ~44% of under-trained tokens, and together with punctuation/uppercase Latin tokens reach ~64.8%, supporting the repo-overfitting hypothesis. (2) Training several small LMs with SA-BPE variants shows a substantial reduction in under-trained tokens versus standard BPE. The provided excerpt does not include the exact model/data/vocab sizes or the precise reduction numbers, so those should be taken from the paper’s main result tables and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Deep-read (1.5–2 hours): (1) start with the under-trained token taxonomy (Analysis + Table 1) to understand what is actually wasted in code vocabularies; (2) carefully read Algorithm 1 and the definitions/measurement of repository and language attribution; (3) study ablations over (Rt, Lt) and different regularized scoring rules and how they reshape the vocabulary; (4) connect to your pretraining pipeline: how repo sampling/dedup changes R/L statistics, and whether improved generality trades off compression (token count) and thus compute under a fixed budget.

recommendation.zh: 把代码tokenizer的“词表过拟合”变成可训练的正则项很实用；建议直接照着source-attribution权重重训一次BPE，看unused token与跨仓库泛化是否立竿见影。
recommendation.en: It makes code-tokenizer overfitting an actionable objective via source-attribution regularization; I’d rerun BPE with their weighting and check unused-token rate + cross-repo generalization as an immediate win.

paper.title: Advancing Polish Language Modeling through Tokenizer Optimization in the Bielik v3 7B and 11B Series

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦“通用 tokenizer 对特定形态丰富语言（波兰语）的结构性低效”。以 Mistral 系通用词表为例，波兰语因屈折变化、变音符号与高词形变体导致被切分成更多子词（高 fertility ratio），从而带来：上下文窗口有效信息密度下降、推理成本上升、生成速度变慢，并可能影响下游质量。
summary.importance: 对单语/区域语言 LLM 来说，tokenizer 是影响训练与推理效率的关键瓶颈之一：更低的 fertility ratio 意味着同样 32k 上下文能容纳更多语义内容、同样吞吐下能处理更长文本。该工作给出在不改变主干架构的情况下，将既有大模型迁移到新 tokenizer 的工程化路线，并强调避免 tokenizer 替换引发的灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）。
summary.technical_approach:
在保持 Bielik v3 7B/11B 架构不变（Mistral 风格 Transformer，含 GQA 与 RoPE，原生 32k context；11B 通过 DUS 扩深到 50 层，7B 由 11B 压缩蒸馏得到）的前提下，核心改动是将原 32,128 通用词表替换为约 32,000 的波兰语优化词表（文中称采用 APT4 tokenizer，并参考/使用 FOCUS 方法进行 tokenizer 替换）。技术要点围绕：
- 目标函数层面：降低波兰语文本的 token 碎片化（fertility ratio），同时尽量保留对英语及其他欧洲语言的覆盖。
- 迁移训练层面：采用多阶段 pre-training + post-training 流水线来适配新词表，并显式以“缓解灾难性遗忘”为设计目标（论文贡献点之一）。
（注：给定全文截断内容未包含更细的训练阶段配方、具体 FOCUS 操作细节与定量 fertility 结果，因此此处仅基于已提供段落概括。）
summary.experiments: 论文报告对象为 Bielik v3 PL 7B 与 11B 两个变体，强调在 tokenizer 替换后通过多阶段训练“保持与原 tokenizer 模型相当的性能”，并开源权重（Apache 2.0）。但在当前提供的正文片段中，尚未出现：具体评测基准、对照组、fertility ratio 的量化对比、以及训练预算/数据配比等关键实验细节，因此无法在摘要中复述具体数值结论。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Tokenizers 章节：抓住 fertility ratio 的定义、波兰语形态特性为何导致碎片化、以及 32k 词表下如何在“更紧凑的波兰语切分”与“跨语言覆盖”间权衡；重点关注 APT4 的规则/训练语料与特殊符号、数字、标点处理策略。
- 方法贡献点：精读 FOCUS 替换 tokenizer 的流程与作者如何降低 catastrophic forgetting（通常涉及嵌入初始化/对齐、渐进式训练或混合词表策略等——以论文原文为准）。
- 训练流水线：逐阶段理解 pre-training 与 post-training 的目标与数据组成，尤其是哪些阶段专门用于恢复通用能力/对齐新分词分布。
skim（泛读）：
- Introduction：了解为何“通用 tokenizer”对波兰语低效以及项目定位。
- Model Architecture：快速确认模型主干不变（GQA、RoPE、DUS、压缩蒸馏）。
- Tokenizers 开头：只需理解 fertility ratio 与效率动机即可。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调：语言特定优化不一定来自更大模型或更复杂架构，tokenizer 这一“输入接口”的匹配度会系统性影响上下文利用率与推理成本。其贡献在于给出 Bielik v3 7B/11B 在替换为波兰语优化词表后仍能维持性能的迁移方案，并以开源权重推动波兰语生态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural inefficiency of universal tokenizers for morphologically rich languages like Polish. With a general-purpose Mistral-style vocabulary, Polish text tends to be split into many more subword pieces (high fertility ratio), which reduces effective context capacity, increases inference cost, slows generation, and can hurt downstream quality.
summary_en.importance: For language-specific or regional LLMs, tokenizer choice is a first-order efficiency lever: lowering fertility ratio increases semantic density per context window and improves throughput/cost. The work provides an engineering pathway to migrate an existing large model family to a new Polish-optimized tokenizer while explicitly aiming to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Keeping the Bielik v3 7B/11B architectures unchanged (Mistral-like Transformer with GQA and RoPE, 32k context; 11B scaled via DUS to 50 layers; 7B obtained by compression/distillation), the main change is replacing the original 32,128-token universal vocabulary with a ~32,000-token Polish-optimized vocabulary (APT4 tokenizer), using the FOCUS approach for tokenizer replacement.
Key themes:
- Objective: reduce Polish token fragmentation (fertility ratio) while maintaining reasonable coverage for English/other European languages.
- Adaptation: a multi-stage pre-training and post-training pipeline designed to preserve performance and reduce catastrophic forgetting after tokenizer swap.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt is truncated before detailed procedural steps and quantitative tokenizer metrics, so this summary is limited to what is present.)
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces Bielik v3 PL 7B and 11B variants, claims performance comparable to the original-tokenizer models after multi-stage training, and releases weights under Apache 2.0. However, in the provided excerpt there are no concrete benchmark tables, fertility-ratio numbers, or training-budget details, so specific quantitative results cannot be restated here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Tokenizers section: focus on fertility ratio, why Polish morphology drives fragmentation, and how APT4 balances compact Polish segmentation with cross-language coverage; pay attention to handling of digits/punctuation/special characters.
- Tokenizer replacement method: read the FOCUS-based procedure and the mechanisms used to mitigate catastrophic forgetting (e.g., embedding alignment/initialization and staged training—per the paper).
- Training pipeline: understand each pre-training/post-training stage and which stages are meant to recover general capability under the new segmentation.
skim (quick pass):
- Introduction: motivation and problem framing.
- Model Architecture: confirm the backbone is unchanged (GQA, RoPE, DUS, compression/distillation).
- Start of Tokenizers: fertility ratio and efficiency motivation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that language-specific gains do not necessarily require larger models or new architectures—tokenizer fit can systematically impact context utilization and inference cost. Their contribution is a practical migration recipe for Bielik v3 7B/11B to a Polish-optimized vocabulary while maintaining performance, plus an open release to support the Polish LLM ecosystem.

recommendation.zh: 只看 tokenizer 迁移流程与遗忘控制的工程细节；结论不惊艳，但能直接指导你给形态丰富语种降 fertility、提吞吐。
recommendation.en: Skim the tokenizer-swap recipe and forgetting controls; not a big conceptual leap, but it’s actionable for lowering fertility and improving throughput in morphologically rich languages.
